articles.title: Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action
articles.content: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs. We study structured pruning for these models, focusing on preserving both scene understanding and trajectory prediction. Our analysis of Taylor importance in Alpamayo-1.5-10B shows that reasoning and trajectory objectives assign different importance to the same vision-language model (VLM) structures. In the action expert, MLP channels exhibit more stable importance rankings across denoising steps than query heads, and a small fraction of channels accounts for most of the measured importance. Based on these findings, we propose MoOP, which combines importance ranks from both objectives for VLM pruning and aggregates stepwise importance to select a fixed subset of expert MLP channels. At 24.0% total parameter reduction, VLM-only pruning with MoOP performs comparably to or slightly better than the strongest baselines in driving, while retaining 94.0% of the dense model's LingoQA score, far above all other methods. At a higher reduction of 30.0%, MoOP degrades much less than every other method, as it is the only one whose reasoning does not collapse. Removing 93.75% of expert MLP channels increases total parameter reduction to 39.4%, with nearly unchanged open-loop errors relative to VLM-only pruning and competitive closed-loop performance. The resulting model achieves a 1.37x end-to-end inference speedup and 36.6% lower peak memory than the dense model, without post-pruning fine-tuning.

articles.content_zh: 用于自主驱动的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型用于引导动作生成的思维链(CoT)推理,但产生大量的内存和计算成本. 我们为这些模型研究结构化的钻探, 重点是保持场景理解和轨迹预测。 我们对泰勒在阿尔帕马约-1.5-10B中的重要性的分析表明,推理和轨迹目标对相同的视觉语言模型结构具有不同的重要性。 在动作专家中,MLP频道在调试步骤上显示比查询头更稳定的重要性排名,一小部分频道占了所测量的重要程度. 根据这些调查结果,我们提议采用 " 业务程序 " ,将VLM穿透目标中的重要性等级与逐步综合的重要性结合起来,以选择一个固定的MLP专家渠道子集。 在总参数减少24.0%时,只有VLM与MOOP进行比对或略优于驾驶中最强的基线,同时保留了密度模型LingoQA分数的94.0%,远高于其他所有方法. 在更低的30.0%时,MOOP的降解比其他方法要少得多,因为它是唯一一个推理不崩溃的方法. 删除93.75%的 MLP 专家通道将总参数减少率提高到39.4%,与 VLM 唯一 的 pruning 和 竞争性的 封闭- loop 性能相比,开放- roop 错误几乎保持不变 。 由此形成的模型实现了1.37x端到端的推论加速,比密集的模型降低了36.6%的峰值内存,没有后推的微调.

articles.title: Lyris: Layout-Guided Long Video Generation with Persistent 3D Memory
articles.content: Exploring a scene from as little as a single photo requires generating a long, camera-controlled walkthrough that extends far beyond what was captured, yet remains consistent upon return. Memory-based video generation methods preserve what they have already seen, but have no anchor beyond it, where the camera drifts from its path and a text prompt can name objects but not place them. Layout-conditioned methods provide such an anchor and precise control over what appears where, but rely on layouts that are typically authored by hand. Both limitations arise because, beyond what was captured, nothing anchors the video model unless a human authors one. To overcome both, we propose Lyris, a long video generation framework that never leaves the video model without an anchor: a persistent point-cloud memory where the scene has been observed or generated, and a 3D layout that a vision-language model authors where it has not. Our key insight is that the interface between the two models can be surprisingly coarse. A layout of one labeled 3D box per object is simple enough for a vision-language model to author (and for a user to edit), yet expressive enough for a video model to follow once rendered along the camera path. We demonstrate walkthroughs of over three minutes and 50 meters from a single photo, passing through doorways into rooms it never shows. When evaluated on minute-long round trips across four datasets, Lyris outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a wide margin, reducing camera error by 3.8x and improving consistency upon return by 22% on average.

articles.title_zh: Lyris:布局引导长视频生成,并带有持续3D内存
articles.content_zh: 探索一个场景,只要只拍一张照片,就需要制作一个长长的摄像机控制通道,它远远超出所捕捉到的场景,但返回后仍保持一致。 基于记忆的视频生成方法保存着他们已经看到的东西,但除了它之外没有锚,摄影机漂移到它的路径上,一个文本提示可以命名物体,但不能放置它们. 以布局为条件的方法提供了这种锚地和对出现地点的精确控制,但依靠通常由手写的布局。 这两种限制都产生,因为除了捕捉到的东西之外,除了人类的作者之外,没有任何东西可以锁定视频模型。 为了克服两者,我们提出Lyris,一个长长的视频生成框架,从不让视频模型没有主播:一个持续的点-云记忆,在现场被观察或生成,以及一个3D布局,一个没有视觉语言模型作者. 我们的关键见解是,这两个模型之间的接口可能令人惊讶地粗糙。 每个对象一个标注3D框的布局,对于一个视觉语言模型来说足够简单,可以让作者(以及一个用户编辑),但足够表现,可以让一个视频模型随相机路径一经渲染就遵循. 我们展示出超过3分钟和50米 从一张照片, 穿过门道进入房间 它从来没有显示。 在经过四套数据集的短时间往返评估时,赖瑞斯的成绩比最先进的方法远,将相机误差减少3.8x,在返回时平均提高22%的一致性.

articles.title: Modern Self-Supervised Vision Transformers Are Pareidolic
articles.content: In human perception, pareidolia is the tendency to perceive a meaningful pattern, such as a face, in a random or ambiguous stimulus.We find a similar phenomenon in modern self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs): on white noise, which contains neither objects nor spatial structure, a few directions of their features still form spatially coherent patterns across the patches, imposed by the features themselves.We call this behavior pareidolia, and the span of these directions the pareidolic subspace.On natural images, it holds most of the feature variance in DINOv2 and DINOv3 but little in DINO.This excess explains why DINOv2 and DINOv3, despite stronger dense features, fall far behind DINO in object emergence, the hallmark ability of self-supervised ViTs to identify the patches of an object on their own.Our experiments further show that scaling down their pareidolic subspaces steadily restores their ability to discover objects, so their object emergence is hindered rather than lost.These findings naturally lead to a training-free calibration: Pareidolia Subspace Calibration(PSC) measures the pareidolic subspace only on a noise input and then calibrates the features of natural inputs by scaling its directions down to the variance level of the remaining directions.Across diverse object emergence tasks, PSC improves DINOv2 and DINOv3 by up to 31.7 CorLoc on object discovery, 30.2 maxF on saliency detection and 59.9~$\mathcal{J}$ on video object segmentation.To identify the cause of pareidolia, we trace it block by block and find that it forms in the middle blocks of every self-supervised model we examine but stays strong to the last block only in models trained with a patch-level loss; controlled training confirms that an image-level loss alone lets it fade.

articles.title_zh: 现代自我监督的愿景变形器 肾上腺素
articles.content_zh: 在人类的认知中,pareidolia是一种在随机或模棱两可的刺激中感知到一种有意义的模式的倾向,如面部. 我们发现现代自我监督的ViT变形器(ViTs)中也有类似现象:在既不包含物体也不包含空间结构的白色噪声上,其特征的几个方向仍然在整个补丁中形成空间一致的图案,这些图案是由特征本身强加的. 我们称这种行为为 pareidolia, 和这些方向的跨度 pareidolic 子空间。 在自然影像上,它持有DINov2和DINov3中的大部分特征差异,但在DINO中却很少. 这种过量解释了为什么DINov2和DINov3尽管有更强的密集特征,但在物体出现时却远远落后于DINO,即自监VITs自行识别物体补丁的标志性能力. 我们的实验进一步表明,缩小它们的pareidolic亚空间稳步恢复它们发现物体的能力,因此它们的物体出现受到阻碍而不是丢失. 这些发现自然导致无训练校准:Pareidolia Subspace校准(PSC)只在噪音输入上测量pareidolic subspace,然后通过缩小方向到其余方向的差异水平来校准自然输入的特征. 在各种对象生成任务中,PSC将DINOv2和DINOv3改进最多31.7 CorLoc关于物体发现,30.2 maxF关于显性探测,59.9~$\mathcal{J}$关于视频物体分割. 为了识别pareidolia的原因,我们逐块追踪它,发现它形成于我们所审查的每一个自我监督的模型的中间块,但只有在受过补丁级损失训练的模型中才能坚固到最后一个块;有控制的训练证实,图像级损失不能让它消失。

articles.title: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
articles.content: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. Leveraging pretrained vision-language models offers a way to build on already learned multimodal knowledge, but making this knowledge effectively accessible to visual generation remains nontrivial. We find that a central challenge lies in the heterogeneous visual representations used for understanding and generation. To address this challenge, we introduce Integral, which converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space across the two capabilities. Integral implements this design through two complementary components. Abstraction Fusion constructs shared visual tokens by aggregating hierarchical representations from the frozen vision encoder, while Block-wise MoT introduces a lightweight generative stream that interacts with the vision-language model only at block boundaries. Our approach effectively preserves the pretrained understanding capability while extending it to strong visual generation. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that sharing visual representations between understanding and generation substantially improves generative learning compared with using a separate visual representation space, despite comparable reconstruction fidelity. These results suggest that representations learned by pretrained vision-language models already provide an effective foundation for visual generation.

articles.title_zh: 让Visual-Language Models通过他们的表达来生成图像
articles.content_zh: 最近的统一的多式联运模式旨在将视觉理解和生成结合在一个单一模式中,但有效整合这两种能力仍然是一项挑战。 利用事先受过训练的视觉语言模型,为在已经学到的多模式知识基础上更上一层楼提供了一种方法,但使视觉一代能够有效地获得这种知识仍然是非三角性的。 我们认为,一个中心挑战在于用于理解和生成的各种视觉表现。 为了应对这一挑战,我们引入了Integrative(Integrative),通过在两种能力之间搭建一个共享的视觉表现空间,将预先训练的视觉语言模型转化为统一的多式联运模型. 综合通过两个互补部分实施这一设计。 抽象融合通过汇总来自冷冻视觉编码器的分级表示来构建共享视觉符号,而Block-wise MOT则引入了轻量级基因流,只在块边界上与视觉语言模型相互作用. 我们的方法有效地保留了事先训练好的理解能力,同时将其扩展到强大的视觉生成. 受控的比较进一步表明,尽管重建忠贞程度相当,但分享理解和世代之间的视觉表现,与使用单独的视觉表现空间相比,大大改进了基因学习。 这些结果表明,通过经过预先训练的视觉语言模型而获得的表述已经为视觉生成提供了有效的基础。

articles.title: TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming
articles.content: CLIP-style dual encoders map images and text through two separate towers into a shared embedding space, where the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap. Retrieval fails when wrong matches, or hard negatives, outrank the correct one, and the gap is the usual suspect. Yet removing it post hoc degrades retrieval on every CLIP checkpoint we test. We introduce a paired statistic that identifies directions where the two towers agree more on hard negatives than on matched pairs. Mildly attenuating these directions improves retrieval while largely preserving the gap. We arrive at this correction through weight-space programming: guided by the statistic, an LLM agent inspects both towers and writes closed-form weight edits without backpropagation. Free to edit any component, the agent improves COCO test retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints and edits an output projection in 12 of the 13. We distill and refine its recurring correction into TowerBridge, a closed-form recipe motivated by a first-order analysis of the hard-negative margin. Computed in seconds from 25,000 labelled pairs, it requires no model-specific tuning and leaves the architecture and inference cost unchanged. TowerBridge improves COCO test retrieval by 16.8 RSUM and Flickr30k test retrieval by 6.6 on average across all 21 evaluated CLIP checkpoints, including 8 unseen by the agent, while limiting any drop in ImageNet zero-shot accuracy to 0.5 points. It also reduces hubness on all 21 checkpoints and improves retrieval on 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families.

articles.title_zh: Tower Bridge:通过重量空间编程缩小双重编码器模式差距
articles.content_zh: CLIP风格的双编码器通过两个独立的塔将图像和文本映射到一个共享的嵌入空间,两种模式占据了被模式间隙分隔的不同区域. 错误匹配时检索失败,或硬负数,排在正确位置后,缺口是通常的疑犯. 但是,移除它后临时功能会降低我们测试的每个CLIP检查站的检索。 我们引入一个对齐统计, 确定两个塔在硬底片上比在配对上更一致的方向。 略微缩小这些方向可以改善检索,同时在很大程度上保持差距。 我们通过加权空间编程实现这种校正:在统计学的指引下,一个LLM代理检查两座塔,并写闭式的重量编辑,而不反射. 该代理可以自由编辑任何组件,改进所有13个CLIP检查站的COCO测试检索,并编辑13个中12个的输出预测. 我们将其反复出现的校正精炼成Tower Bridge,一种封闭式配方,以硬负差的一阶分析为动机. 从25,000个标签对数中数秒计算出来,它不需要特定的模型调制,而使架构和推论成本保持不变. TowerBridge在所有21个经评价的CLIP检查站平均改进了16.8 RSUM的COCO测试检索和6.6的Flickr30k测试检索,包括代理商看不见的8个,同时将ImageNet零射精度的任何下降限制在0.5点。 该系统还减少了所有21个检查站的枢纽性,改进了从其他家庭取回5个双重编码器中的4个。

articles.title: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
articles.content: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks. Despite its success in supervised learning, DD remains underexplored in self-supervised learning (SSL), where distilled data must preserve the information needed to learn representations that remain consistent across augmentations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mutual Information Prototype Alignment (MIPA), an efficient SSL dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information. Specifically, MIPA treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes and uses a frozen encoder to assign real samples to them based on feature similarity. A synthetic dataset that preserves such augmentation invariance should yield stable prototype assignments across multiple augmented views of the same real image. MIPA encourages this by maximizing mutual information between cross-view assignments while avoiding trivial solutions in which all real samples are assigned to only a few synthetic prototypes. Evaluations on image classification benchmarks show that synthetic data generated by MIPA yield higher-quality representations than existing distillation approaches while reducing time and storage demands during distillation.

articles.title_zh: 通过互通信息进行自我监督的数据集蒸馏
articles.content_zh: 数据集蒸馏(DD)旨在将一个大型数据集压缩成一个小型的合成数据集,这个数据集对于训练神经网络依然有效. 尽管在有监督的学习方面取得了成功,但DD在自我监督的学习(SSL)中仍然没有得到充分利用,在那里,提取的数据必须保存学习在各种扩展中始终一致的表述所需的信息。 为了弥合这一差距,我们采用了相互信息原型对齐(MIPA),这是一种高效的SSL数据集蒸馏方法,优化合成图像以保存增强-变异信息. 具体来说,MIPA将合成图像视为可学习的原型,并使用冷冻编码器根据特征相似性给它们分配真正的样品. 保存这种增量变化的合成数据集应产生稳定的原型任务,涵盖同一真实图像的多重增量观点。 MIPA鼓励这样做,在交叉查看任务之间尽量扩大相互信息,同时避免琐碎的解决办法,即所有真正的样品只分配给少数合成原型. 对图像分类基准的评价表明,MIPA生成的合成数据比现有的蒸馏方法能产生更高质量的表现,同时减少蒸馏过程中的时间和存储需求.

articles.title: CTLink: A Text-Prompted Segmentation Model for Linking Radiology Report Findings to 3D Chest CT Scans
articles.content: Radiology reports describe findings in text only, without visually marking them on the scan, so readers cannot directly see which abnormality each reported finding refers to. We introduce CTLink, a text-prompted 3D segmentation model that segments findings described in a chest CT report. CTLink was trained on 4123 noncontrast chest CT scans with 9547 segmented report findings, including ReXGroundingCTv2, a newly annotated dataset of 1134 scans and 1895 findings with every instance of each finding segmented. On the 200 ReXGroundingCT validation scans, CTLink achieved a hit rate of 0.816, an instance F1 score of 0.456, and a mean Dice score of 0.400, compared with 0.533, 0.175, and 0.234 for VoxTell, a publicly available text-prompted segmentation model (P < .001 for all). On the test set of the MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding challenge, an ensemble of seven CTLink models achieved the highest hit rate (0.782) and instance F1 score (0.386) of all 48 participating teams. On 50 test scans segmented twice by independent radiologists, CTLink matched or exceeded inter-rater agreement. Diffuse non-focal findings remained the main limitation, partly because their extent is outlined inconsistently even between radiologists. The CTLink model weights are available at https://huggingface.co/rajpurkarlab/CTLink, and the dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/rajpurkarlab/ReXGroundingCT.

articles.title_zh: CTLink:将放射学报告结果与3D胸口CT连接起来的文本预分模型 扫描
articles.content_zh: 放射学报告只在文字中描述发现,没有在扫描中以视觉标记,因此读者无法直接看到每个报道的发现指的是哪一种异常. 我们引入了CTLink,一种文本催化的3D分解模型,它分解了胸前CT报告中描述的发现. CTLink接受了关于4123个非连续胸腔CT扫描的培训,其中包含9547个分块报告结果,包括REXGroundingCTv2,一个新附加说明的数据集,包含1134个扫描和1895个分块每个实例的发现. 在200 ReXGroundingCT验证扫描中,CTLink实现了0.816的命中率,实例F1的得分为0.456,平均Dice的得分为0.400,相比之下,0.533,0.175,而VoxTell的0.234是公开使用的文本促分模型(P < 001). 在MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding挑战赛的试训集上,由7个CTLink型号组成的综艺节目实现了最高的命中率(0.782)和所有48支参赛球队的例F1分(0.386). 在50次测试扫描中,独立放射学家进行了两次分解,CTLink匹配或超过了双方的协议. Diffuse非焦点结论仍然是主要限制,部分原因是其程度在放射科医生之间也不一致。 CTLink模型权重见https://huggingface.co/rajpurkarlab/CTLink,数据集见https://huggingface.co/datasets/rajpurkarlab/REXGroundingCT。

articles.title: LeJEPA Features Are Not Isotropic, and Should Not Be
articles.content: The SIGReg term in LeJEPA regularizes features to have an isotropic Gaussian distribution. Our first result is to show that this regularizer, in practice, cannot achieve its goal. We design a modified regularizer to enforce the objective better. This leads to slightly improved performance. For example, on ImageNet-100, our modified regularizer reaches the final accuracy of SIGReg in 1.3$\times$ fewer epochs. Our second result argues that self-supervised encoders should not have isotropic Gaussian features. We show that the alignment term in LeJEPA conflicts with SIGReg, because it couples the magnitude of the features with their directions. In contrast, isotropic Gaussian features would entail independent magnitude and directions. Features obtained with LeJEPA are, in fact, not isotropic. So LeJEPA has two issues. Its regularizer is weak, and the isotropic Gaussian target is too strict. Our third result is about reformulating the isotropic Gaussian regularizer to enforce only the marginal distributions of the magnitude and direction, without enforcing independence. This leads to a simple regularization term, PolarReg, that can be optimized reliably across many different datasets, batch sizes and embedding dimensions without any hyper-parameter changes. On ImageNet-1k, our technique matches the accuracy of LeJEPA and its variants in 4.7$\times$ fewer epochs. It improves the final accuracy by 1.8 points.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LeJEPA 地物不是异热带的,不应该是
articles.content_zh: LeJEPA中的SIGREG术语将特征规范化,以具有异热带的高斯分布. 我们的第一个结果是表明,这个常态化者实际上无法实现其目标。 我们设计了一个经过修改的规范器来更好地执行目标. 这导致业绩略有改善。 例如,在ImageNet-100上,我们经过修改的正则器以1.3美元\times$更少的时代达到SIGREG的最终精度. 我们的第二个结果认为,自我监督的编码器不应该具有异色高斯的特征. 我们显示,LeJEPA中的校正术语与SIGREG冲突,因为它将特征的大小与其方向相配. 与此相反,异热带高斯的特征将带来独立的规模和方向。 与LeJEPA合作获得的特征事实上不是异热带的. 因此,LeJEPA有两个问题. 其常态器弱,异形高斯靶太严格. 我们的第三个结果是重塑异热带高斯常态器,只执行大小和方向的边际分布,而不执行独立性. 这导致一个简单的规范化术语PolarReg,可以可靠地在很多不同的数据集,批量大小和嵌入维度上进行优化,而没有任何超参数变化. 在ImageNet-1k上,我们的技术与LeJEPA及其变体的精度相匹配,以4.7美元\times$更少的时代. 它使最终准确度提高了1.8分.

articles.title: WorldLatent: A Unified 4D Latent Space for World Perception and Generation
articles.content: Generative Pre-Training (GPT) represents a profound milestone in natural language processing, serving as the foundation for most of today's state-of-the-art large language models. By casting diverse understanding and generation problems into a shared token representation, GPT enables a single architecture and unified optimization loop to master heterogeneous tasks across massive corpora, giving rise to powerful foundation models for natural language. In contrast, 4D spatiotemporal vision lacks a common representational protocol: perception (such as depth and camera estimation) and generation are either handled by separate one-way pipelines or bolted together from unaligned single-modality spaces. In this work, we introduce WorldLatent, a framework that formulates a unified 4D latent space as a common protocol for both world perception and generation. Rather than relying on fragmented, task-specific models or stacked single-modality representations, our framework proposes a multimodal VAE architecture that compresses and fuses complex 4D visual appearance, geometry, and dynamics into a single structured latent representation. Within this formulation, perception and generation operate as complementary denoising processes over the same latent space, enabling one generative model to learn both capabilities simultaneously within a single training loop. Experiments across representative 4D benchmarks verify that our fused latent protocol achieves specialist-level zero-shot 4D perception, coherent 4D generation, and controllable editing from a single model. By demonstrating that diverse 4D tasks can be seamlessly unified under a shared representational protocol, our work provides a scalable foundation for general-purpose 4D spatial intelligence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WorldLatent:一个面向世界认知和一代的统一4D后期空间
articles.content_zh: Generative Pre-Training(GPT)代表了自然语言处理的一个深刻里程碑,是当今大多数最先进的大语言模型的基础. GPT通过将不同的理解和生成问题投放到一个共同的代号代表中,使得一个单一的架构和统一优化的循环能够掌握跨大块体的异形任务,从而产生了强大的自然语言基础模型. 相比之下,4D spatiotemporal视觉缺乏一个共同的表示协议:感知(如深度和相机估计)和生成要么通过单独的单向管道处理,要么从不协调的单模式空间中栓在一起. 在这项工作中,我们引入了WorldLatent,这个框架将一个统一的4D潜伏空间作为世界认知和一代的共同协议. 我们的框架不依靠零散、具体任务模式或堆叠的单一模式表示,而是提出一种将复杂的4D视觉外观、几何和动态压缩和引信成单一结构化潜在表示的多式联运VAE结构。 在这个配方中,感知和生成是在同一潜在空间上互补的消音过程,使一个基因模型能够在单一的培训循环中同时学习两种能力。 跨越具有代表性的4D基准的实验证实,我们的熔化潜在协议实现了专家级的零射4D感知,一致的4D生成,以及从单一模型中可控制的编辑. 通过展示多种4D任务在共享代表协议下可以无缝统一,我们的工作为通用4D空间智能提供了可扩展的基础.

articles.title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
articles.content: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ToolSmith:多式联运搜索代理工具自动生成框架
articles.content_zh: 最近多模式搜索代理使用推理、视觉和网络现场搜索等多种方式,通过组织一个手动搜索和视觉工具的小型图书馆来回答超出参数化知识的问题。 然而,当在野外遇到新的查询类型,证据格式,以及故障模式时,图书馆很难创建和维护,并被冻结. 相比之下,人类从业者则通过从熟悉的部分形成新的工具并跨任务再利用这些工具来解决工具不足的问题。 受此启发,我们提出 ToolSmith,一个自动工具生成框架,在精益基工具库上生长和再利用模块. 我们评价了根据VLM-as-a-Judge协议的三项域内多式联运搜索基准和十项域外基准。 ToolSmith在各种规模的部署人员中不断改进基础库,更大的骨干力量收获了更大的收益,显示了这一方法的可扩展性。 我们的代码和数据见https://teesr.github.io/toolsmith/。

articles.title: On-Policy Codec Distillation for Efficient All-in-One Video Generation
articles.content: Modern visual generative models operate on tokens, and every visual asset they receive, whether an identity, a scribble, a depth map, or a motion video, is tokenized and appended to the input token sequence. Consequently, conditioning quickly dominates the computation cost. Yet most of these tokens carry redundant spatiotemporal information. Our key insight is that identifying what is genuinely new is exactly the problem that classical video codecs have long solved. Thus, we first introduce a codec-based token pruning method that discards redundant tokens. Then, we propose an on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) strategy to train a DiT adapter capable of learning the codec pruning pattern well without quality degradation. Together, they form On-Policy Codec Distillation (CodecOPSD). We scale CodecOPSD to 16 condition modalities on our own video diffusion model, where it prunes 66% of the condition tokens on average with almost no quality drop. Therefore, denoising becomes 2x faster, and the cache memory shrinks by up to 73% in KV cache mode. CodecOPSD also extends to other state-of-the-art pretrained image and video generative models, where its benefit grows further with more conditions, longer frames, and higher resolution.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 高效全能视频生成的消音
articles.content_zh: 现代视觉基因模型在符号上运作,它们得到的每一个视觉资产,无论是身份,拼写图,深度图,还是运动视频,都是以符号表示,并附在输入符号序列上. 因此,计算费用很快以调制为主。 然而,大多数这些符号都带有多余的瞬间信息。 我们的关键洞察力是,识别真正新的东西正是古典视频解码器早已解决的问题。 因此,我们首先采用了一种基于解码器的代号调试方法,丢弃冗余代号. 然后,我们提出一个政策上的自我消化(OPSD)策略,来训练一个DiT适配器,能够在不发生质量退化的情况下很好地学习解码器的穿透模式. 它们共同组成了On-Political Codec Distruction(CodecOPSD). 将CodecOPSD 放大到16种条件模式 在我们的视频传播模型上, 它平均在66%的 条件符号上 平均没有质量下降。 因此,去诺化成为2x更快,缓存内存在KV缓存模式中缩水高达73%. CodecOPSD还扩展到其他最先进的预先训练的图像和视频基因模型,其好处随着更多的条件,更长的帧,更高的分辨率而进一步增长.

articles.title: SPROUT: Predicting Objective-Grounded Prompt Utility for Efficient Text-to-Image Preference Tuning
articles.content: Preference tuning of text-to-image diffusion models spends most of its compute generating candidate images, yet training prompts are typically sampled uniformly at random, wasting compute generating images that provide too little signal for model alignment. To best utilize the available compute, we study prompt selection, where at each iteration we identify the most useful prompts for preference tuning. We separate prompt selection into a utility score, an estimator of that utility score, and batch selection. Within this framework, we propose Selection by PRedicting Objective-grounded UTility (SPROUT). The utility score is predicted on every prompt in the pool, including unseen prompts, by a text-only model, refit after every iteration on all utilities observed so far. A randomized acceptance rule then turns these predictions into a batch, so no images are generated beyond those used for training. For direct group preference optimization (DGPO), the objective-grounded utility is the norm of the gradient that the objective produces from a prompt's group of images. Fine-tuning Stable Diffusion 1.5 with DGPO on GenEval, SPROUT matches the final score of uniform sampling in about 44% of the iterations and improves the area under the learning curve with respect to both uniform sampling and CGPO, a recent variance-based prompt sampler. The efficiency gains hold under four held-out reward models never used in training, and the ranking of methods carries over to DPG-Bench and T2I-CompBench++. Our code is available at https://github.com/ADDAPT-ML/SPROUT.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SPROUT: 用于高效文本对图像的快速工具
articles.content_zh: 文本到图像传播模型的首选调试使用其计算生成候选图像的大部分时间,然而培训提示通常以随机方式统一取样,浪费了计算生成图像,这些图像为模型校对提供了太少的信号. 为了最好地利用现有的计算方法,我们研究快速选择,在每个周期,我们都会找出最有用的调整优惠的提示。 我们把即时选择分为公用事业分数、公用事业分数的估算和批量选择。 在这一框架内,我们提议通过基于目标的统一选择。 公用设备的分数通过文本专用模式在池内每个提示(包括未见提示)上预测,在所有公用设备的每次迭代之后再进行更新。 随机接受规则然后将这些预测变成一个批次,因此除了用于训练的图像外,没有生成任何图像. 对于直接的分组偏好优化(DGPO),基于目标的效用是目标从一个提示的一组图像产生的梯度的规范. SPROUT在GenEval上与DGPO对调稳定扩散1.5,在大约44%的迭代中匹配统一采样的最终得分,并在统一采样和CGPO这一最近基于差异的快速采样器方面改善学习曲线下的区域。 在培训中从未使用过的4个搁置奖励模式下,效率收益得到维持,方法的排名延续到DPG-Bench和T2I-CompBench++。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/ADAPT-ML/SPROUT上查阅。

articles.title: Analyzing and Improving FlowMap Distillation of Autoregressive Video Models
articles.content: FlowMap distillation offers a natural route to few-step generative modeling by directly learning a teacher's denoising trajectories. Yet for autoregressive (AR) video generation, existing few-step models still rely on distribution matching distillation (DMD) to remain competitive, sacrificing sample diversity and requiring a large bidirectional teacher. In this work, we analyze what limits standalone AR FlowMap distillation and introduce two complementary guidance mechanisms to close this gap: (1) anti-drifting guidance, which helps the AR teacher correct drifted student rollouts by training an auxiliary model to mimic student drift and using it as a negative guidance branch; and (2) motion-aware guidance, which makes motion easier for a FlowMap student to learn by locating motion patches and selectively applying skip-layer guidance. Empirically, our approach applies to $π$-Flow, MeanFlow, and consistency distillation with 1.3B AR teachers, improving generation quality and reducing drift over 30 s rollouts. Notably, our 4-step $π$-Flow students match DMD students distilled from 14B teachers on VBench while preserving the sample diversity of their AR teachers, demonstrating that pure FlowMap distillation is effective for few-step autoregressive video generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 分析和改进自动回归视频模型的流程图分解
articles.content_zh: FlowMap蒸馏通过直接学习教师的去诺化轨迹,为几步基因模型提供了自然途径. 然而,对于自动递归(AR)视频生成,现有的几步模式仍然依赖配送匹配的蒸馏(DMD)保持竞争力,牺牲了样本的多样性,需要一位大型双向教师. 在这项工作中,我们分析什么限制了独立的AR FlowMap蒸馏,并引入了两种互补的指导机制来缩小这一差距:(1) 防漂移指导,通过训练辅助模型模仿学生漂移并将其作为负向导分支,帮助AR教师校正漂流学生的推出;(2) 运动意识指导,通过定位运动补丁和有选择地应用跳层指导,使流水学生更容易运动学习. 从经验上讲,我们的方法适用于美元-日元、平均日元和与1.3BAR教师的一致蒸馏,提高生产质量,减少30次推出的漂移。 值得注意的是,我们的四步$ $ $ – Flow学生在保持其AR教师的样本多样性的同时,与从V Bench上的14B教师中提取的DMD学生匹配,表明纯FlowMap蒸馏对几步自动视频生成有效.

articles.title: Tokens as Locality-Preserving Anchors: Scalable Novel View Synthesis with Target-Adaptive Token Routing
articles.content: Transformer-based view synthesis models render each target viewpoint from the source images, without an explicit 3D representation, which lets them reproduce fine detail and view-dependent effects. However, their decoder attends to every source token for every frame, so rendering slows with each source image. Rasterization avoids this by culling primitives that the viewpoint does not see, but source tokens cannot be culled this way, as they have no explicit position or extent. Our key insight is that source tokens are nonetheless spatial anchors: each encodes a local region of the scene, so the decoder's attention for any viewpoint concentrates on a few of them. A lightweight router predicts these tokens from the source tokens and the viewpoint, and the decoder attends only to a fixed budget of top-ranked tokens, so its cost no longer depends on the number of source tokens. We supervise the router with the decoder's attention, using non-maximum suppression to demote redundant tokens. With 24 source images and two views' worth of tokens, our model renders 6.4 times faster than LagerNVS, at a PSNR only 0.68 dB lower. One ranking serves every budget, so the budget can change at render time.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 作为本地保存的插件 锁定器:可缩放的小说视图合成,并带有目标可调速的托肯运行
articles.content_zh: 基于变形器的视图合成模型将每个目标视角从源图像中渲染出来,没有明确的3D表示,这使得它们可以复制精细的细节和依赖视图的效果. 然而,他们的解码器处理每个帧的每个源符号,因此渲染速度与每个源图像缓慢. rasterization通过挤压观点所看不到的原始人来避免这种情况,但源符号不能这样挤压,因为它们没有明确的位置或范围. 我们的关键洞察力是,源符号仍然是空间锚:每个符号都编码了场景的局部区域,所以任何观点的解码器注意力都集中在其中的几个. 轻量级路由器从源代码和视角来预测这些令牌,解码器只参加排名最高的令牌的固定预算,因此其成本不再取决于源令牌的数量. 我们用解码器的注意力监督路由器,使用非最大压制来降级多余的代币. 有了24个源图像和两个视图的值值,我们的模型使6.4倍于LagerNVS,在PSNR中只降低0.68 dB. 每个预算都有一个排名,因此预算可以随时变化。

articles.title: Head Anything: Correspondence-Guided Joint Generation of 3D Heads from Few Images
articles.content: Large image-to-3D generators recover detailed heads from a single photograph but treat every image as a new object. For several images of one person, they hallucinate unseen regions independently without using information from the other images. We present Head Anything, which generates detailed head meshes from a few images with changing expressions and viewpoints. Instead of training a multi-image prior, we turn a pretrained single-image generator with a native 3D latent space into a joint generator that denoises all images together. Since global attention between images is hard to learn from scarce 3D head data, lightweight correspondence-attention adapters let every 3D token attend only to its corresponding points in the other images. We obtain correspondences by fitting a neural parametric head model to the generator's own single-image outputs, requiring no ground truth at test time. Training on both ground-truth and fitted correspondences makes the adapters robust to fitting errors. Each mesh stays pixel-aligned with its own image and borrows the unseen regions from all others. On head scans, Head Anything lowers the head Chamfer distance of the best image-to-3D generator by 32% and its cross-frame inconsistency by 47%, and its meshes improve face tracking. Code and models will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 标题 Anything: 信使- Guided 联合生成来自很少图像的 3D 头
articles.content_zh: 大型的图像到-3D生成器从一张照片中回收详细的头,但把每个图像都当作一个新的物体. 对于一个人的几个图像来说,他们不使用其他图像的信息,就独立地幻觉了看不见的区域. 我们呈现“头什么”,它从几个画面中产生详细的头部,并带有变化的表达和观点。 而不是训练一个多图像前, 我们把一个预先训练的 单图像生成器 与本地的 3D 潜伏空间 变成一个联合生成器, 将所有图像都一起隐藏。 由于图像之间的全球关注很难从稀缺的3D头数据中学习,所以轻量级的函授-注意适配器让每个3D令牌只注意其在其他图像中的相应点. 我们通过安装一个神经参数头模型 来获取通信 用于生成器的单像输出 关于地面真相和装配通信的培训使适配器能够很好地适应错误。 每个网格保持像素与自己的图像相匹配,并向所有其他区域借阅看不见的区域。 在头部扫描中,"头任何东西"将最佳图像到3D生成器的头部Chamfer距离降低32%,其跨帧不一致度降低47%,它的网格改善了面部跟踪. 将发布代码和模型。

articles.title: HoloSplat: Real-Time Token Streaming for Feed-Forward Human Reconstruction
articles.content: Live free-viewpoint video streaming of humans enables immersive telepresence and interactive XR applications. However, this requires reconstructing each frame in real time, transmitting the data within strict bandwidth budgets, and decoding it on lightweight client GPUs. Existing approaches, whether relying on per-frame optimization or feed-forward inference, generate massive 3D Gaussian payloads that exceed practical streaming limits, while aggressive compression severely degrades rendering quality. In this work, we present HoloSplat, a real-time streaming framework for human-centric volumetric video. HoloSplat splits a feed-forward reconstructor before its Gaussian head, introducing a multi-rate streaming codec driven by server-side token compression and client-side token restoration. On the server side, we apply opacity-guided token pruning, PCA-based dimensionality reduction, and lossless geometry coding for token anchors. On the client side, a feature reconstruction hypernetwork is fused into the Gaussian head to recover compression-induced quality loss. Furthermore, we introduce Neural Session Calibration (NSC), which rapidly fine-tunes the Gaussian head online using incoming camera views during a warm-up phase. This resolves quality degradation from novel camera parameters and varying capture conditions with zero per-frame overhead. In our evaluations, HoloSplat averages 32.2 FPS on four RTX 5090 GPUs at 50 Mbit/s. It decodes each frame into 3D Gaussians in 22.1 ms on an RTX 3050 Ti laptop GPU, transmitting 22.8$\times$ less data than uncompressed float32 Gaussians, while calibrated decoding improves PSNR by 1.050 dB.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HoloSplat:实时调试用于Feed-Forward人类重建
articles.content_zh: 人类的直播自由视点视频流可以实现浸泡式远程存在和交互XR应用. 然而,这需要实时重建每个帧,在严格的带宽预算范围内传输数据,并在轻量级客户端GPU上解码. 现有的方法,无论是依靠每帧优化还是饲料推论,生成超过实际流线限制的大规模3D高斯有效载荷,而积极的压缩则严重降低渲染质量. 在这部作品中,我们呈现了HoloSplat,一个以人为中心的量子视频的实时流线框架. HoloSplat在它的高斯头之前将一个向导的重建器分割开来,引入了由服务器边的符号压缩和客户端边的符号修复驱动的多速率流代码. 在服务器方面,我们采用不透明制导的代号推算法,基于PCA的维度减值法,以及无损几何编码的代号主锚法. 在客户端,一个功能重建超网络被连接到高斯头,以恢复压缩引起的质量损失. 此外,我们引入了神经会话校准(NSC),它利用热身阶段的摄像头对高斯人的头进行快速微调。 这解决了新式相机参数的质量退化问题,并解决了每帧零的捕获条件。 在我们的评价中,HoloSplate平均在4个RTX 5090 GPU上以50 Mbit/s的速度得到32.2 FPS. 它在一台RTX 3050 Ti笔记本电脑GPU上将每个帧解码为22.1 mss的3D Gaussians,传输的数据比未压缩的浮标32 Gaussians少22.8$\times$,而校准的解码则以1.050 dB改进了PSNR.

articles.title: SRCWDNet: Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network for Multi-Label Remote Sensing Scene Classification
articles.content: Multi-label remote sensing scene classification remains a challenging task due to complex spatial-spectral patterns, extreme class imbalance, and inter-label dependencies that are often insufficiently modeled. To address these challenges, we introduce a Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network (SRCWDNet), which integrates three key modules: (1) a Cross-Window Attention module that captures local and global visual context through learnable global tokens; (2) a Dual Label-Graph module that adaptively combines statistical co-occurrence graphs and learned semantic-embedding graphs to facilitate label-relational reasoning; and (3) a Neural Classifier Chain that sequentially predicts labels to exploit inter-label dependencies. Evaluated using five-fold cross-validation and trained with an Asymmetric-Graph-Consistency loss, SRCWDNet achieves accuracies of 98.93% and 96.53%, with corresponding F1-scores of 0.9365 and 0.8723 on the MLRSNet and China-MAS50k datasets, respectively, outperforming CNN, transformer, and lightweight baselines. These findings demonstrate that jointly modeling visual attention and adaptive label correlations can substantially improve multi-label remote sensing scene classification, particularly under long-tailed class distributions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SRCWDNet:多标签遥感场景分类的语义-关系跨窗口双格网
articles.content_zh: 多标签遥感场景分类仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务,因为空间-光谱模式复杂,阶级失衡严重,标签间依赖性往往不够完善。 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了一个语义-关系-跨视窗双格网(SRCWDNet),它融合了三个主要模块: (1)跨窗口关注模块,通过可学习的全球符号来捕捉本地和全球视觉环境; (2)双标签-图形模块,适应性地结合统计共聚图和已学习的语义-嵌入图,以便于标签-关系推理; (3)神经分类链,依次预测标签,以利用标签间依赖性. SRCWDNet利用5倍的交叉验证并经过非对称-Graph-Consistency损失培训,实现了98.93%和96.53%的速率,在MLRSNet和China-MAS50k数据集上相应的F1分数分别为0.9365和0.8723,均优于CNN,变压器和轻量基线. 这些研究结果表明,联合建模视觉关注度和适应性标签相关性可以大大改进多标签遥感场景分类,特别是在长尾类分布下.

articles.title: CrownFusion: 3D Dental Crown Generation Using Geometry Images and Latent Diffusion
articles.content: We introduce CrownFusion, a latent diffusion model to generate 3D dental crown designs from geometry images, a 2D-grid encoding of surface coordinates. Departing from traditional approaches that use point clouds, our "CrownImage" representation not only unlocks the full power of image-based generative architectures, but also preserves fine geometric detail by operating at far higher spatial resolutions than point clouds to alleviate smoothing artifacts in the 3D generation. Conditioned on jointly learned embeddings of the surrounding dentition, our probabilistic diffusion model produces anatomically plausible crowns with morphological variations tailored to individual patient cases. To accommodate multiple valid designs, we propose an occlusal fit metric based on proximity to the antagonist teeth. We evaluate our method through quantitative experiments and qualitative studies involving expert testimonials. We also release the FDI 16 Crown Dataset, comprising 11,513 annotated intra-oral scans, to support future research in dental CAD.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 皇室联合: 3D 利用几何图像和晚期扩散生成牙科皇冠
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了CrownFusion,一种潜在的扩散模型,从几何图像中生成3D的牙冠设计,一种表面坐标的2D格编码. 脱离使用点云的传统方法,我们的"CrownImage"代表不仅解锁了基于图像的基因架构的全部功率,而且通过在远高于点云的空间分辨率操作来保存精细的几何细节,以缓解3D代的平滑文物. 我们的概率扩散模型以共同学习的周围凹陷嵌入为条件,产生了解剖学上可行的冠冕,其形态变化适合个别病人的情况。 为了适应多种有效的设计,我们提出一个基于靠近对角齿的闭合度量度. 我们通过涉及专家证词的定量实验和定性研究来评估我们的方法。 我们还发布了外国直接投资16 Crown数据集,其中包括11 513个附加说明的口腔扫描,以支持今后在牙科CAD方面的研究。

articles.title: WeaveVLA: 3D Relational Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Models
articles.content: Vision-language-action (VLA) models leverage pretrained vision-language representations for instruction-conditioned robot control, yet their understanding of task-relevant 3D relations and how these relations evolve during manipulation remains largely implicit. To address this challenge, we introduce \textbf{WeaveVLA}, a framework that enhances VLA action generation by explicitly modeling task-relevant relative 3D relations and maintaining relational context across observations. WeaveVLA employs a task-conditioned sparse graph neural network to encode relative 3D relations among objects, the gripper, and nearby references. Pair-specific recurrent edge states integrate geometric evidence across observations to maintain evolving spatial context. A learned-query readout summarizes the updated graph representations into compact relational tokens, which condition the action expert alongside the original vision-language context. An auxiliary geometry reconstruction objective further encourages spatial structure preservation. We instantiate WeaveVLA on StarVLA-GR00T and $π_{0.5}$, achieving over 98\% average success on LIBERO with both backbones. On LIBERO-Plus, WeaveVLA improves success from 74.9\% to 82.0\% and from 85.7\% to 87.8\%, respectively, with additional improvements on CALVIN D$\rightarrow$D. On three real-world tasks, the StarVLA-GR00T-based variant improves average success from 55.6\% to 70.0\% under standard conditions and from 33.3\% to 53.3\% under OOD perturbations, surpassing the $π_{0.5}$ baseline in both settings.

articles.title: RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?
articles.content: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging. We argue that a critical, often overlooked factor is the robot-use interface (RUI), which determines how agents express and execute physical actions. To systematically study its impact, we introduce RUIBench, comprising 30 manipulation tasks across five suites spanning world knowledge, in-context learning, discovery, dynamic interaction, and contact-rich manipulation. We further develop RUIKit, a unified framework that crosses six action abstractions with two interaction forms, yielding 13 interfaces under shared perception and control. In simulation, changing only the RUI shifts a frontier agent's success rate from 45% to 81%, and that of a fine-tuned 4B model from 13% to 47%. Our analysis reveals that effective interfaces reduce unnecessary decisions while preserving essential feedback, with their benefits shaped by agent behavior and physical uncertainty. We further uncover a verification gap, where agents frequently declare success despite observable failures, revealing the need for task-level verification beyond individual actions. Together, these findings establish RUI design as a critical factor in embodied agent reliability.

articles.title_zh: RUIBENCH:什么使一个良好的机器人使用界面?
articles.content_zh: 基础模型可以解释复杂的物理任务,然而将这种智能转化为可靠的机器人执行仍然具有挑战性. 我们争辩说,机器人-使用界面(RUI)是一个关键且经常被忽视的因素,它决定了特工如何表达和执行物理动作. 为了系统地研究其影响,我们引入了RUIBENCH, 包括跨越世界知识、内文学习、发现、动态互动和丰富的接触操纵的五个套件的30个操纵任务。 我们进一步发展了RUIKit,这个统一框架跨越了6个动作抽象和两种互动形式,在共同感知和控制下产生13个界面. 在模拟中,只改变RUI将前沿代理的成功率从45%转移到81%,而微调后的4B模型的成功率从13%调到47%. 我们的分析表明,有效的接口减少了不必要的决定,同时保留了基本的反馈,其好处是由代理人行为和身体不确定性决定的。 我们进一步发现一个核查差距,即尽管存在明显的失败,但代理人经常宣布成功,这表明除了个别行动之外,还需要进行任务一级的核查。 这些结论共同确定RUI的设计是体现的物剂可靠性的一个关键因素。

articles.title: Leakage-Safe Auditing of Attribution-Driven Data Curation in Medical Imaging
articles.content: When can an attribution-derived anomaly justify changing a medical-imaging training set? We formulate attribution-driven curation as three separately testable claims: anomaly detection, harmfulness estimation, and intervention utility. We test the first and third using a patient-disjoint, identifier-preserving audit of a 3D convolutional classifier for computed tomography angiography aneurysm candidates. We identify 232 exactly zero-valued arrays among 1,201 positive patches, including 170 training positives, and invalidate a historical 321-patch attention-failure subgroup whose identifier-free records were joined to files by position. On the held-out test set, GradCAM++ spatial concentration is central for every candidate class, reversing the historical pattern. GradCAM++ and Integrated Gradients show negative rank-order agreement for positives, limiting method-independent anatomical interpretation. Across five paired training seeds, removing the 170 corrupted training positives yields AUC 0.9617 +/- 0.0044 versus 0.9652 +/- 0.0039 for full-data training (difference -0.0035; 95% CI -0.0082 to 0.0007). Excluding 34 raw-zero test positives widens rather than closes the gap, countering a blank-memorization explanation. Budget-matched random-removal controls suggest the result is not simply an effect of reducing training size. Input corruption does not necessarily imply that deletion improves generalization. Our framework makes leakage control, sample identity, and intervention testing explicit in attribution-driven medical-imaging data curation.

articles.title_zh: 医疗成像中渗漏-安全审计-扭曲数据校验
articles.content_zh: 由归属引起的异常现象何时可以证明改变医疗成像培训的正当性? 我们把归因法作为三个可单独检验的主张:异常检测、危害性估计和干预效用。 我们通过对计算成像血管造影动脉瘤候选人的 3D 演化分级器的 病人-脱节、识别识别 来测试第一和第三 我们在1,201个正补丁中识别出232个完全为零值的阵列,包括170个训练正补丁,并且使一个历史321个patch关注-故障分组失效,该分组的无标识记录按位置并入文件. 在搁置测试集上,GradCAM++空间集中是每个候选类的中心,扭转了历史模式. GradCAM++和集成阶梯对正态显示负阶序一致,限制了方法独立的解剖解释. 在五对训练种子中,除去170个腐败训练阳性者后,AUC 0.9617 +/- 0.0044对0.9652 +/- 0.0039进行全数据训练(差数-0.0035;95% CI-0.0082至0.0007)。 不包括34个原始零试验阳性值,会扩大而不是缩小差距,从而抵消空白的模拟解释。 与预算相称的随机搬迁控制表明,结果不仅仅是减少培训规模的效果。 输入腐败并不一定意味着删除会改进概括。 我们的框架使渗漏控制、样本识别和干预测试在归属驱动的医疗成像数据校验中明确。

articles.title: Wrist-Camera Video Diffusion as Generalizable Robot Policies
articles.content: A generalist manipulation policy should perform new tasks, operate in unfamiliar scenes, and transfer skills across robot embodiments. We present Wrist Video Policy (WVP), a closed-loop manipulation framework that learns how manipulation unfolds through video prediction and recovers executable motion through geometric estimation. Our key idea is to represent robot motion through wrist-camera trajectories, which determine the corresponding end-effector poses through a fixed hand-eye transformation. We pair a video generator that predicts future wrist views with a pose estimator adapted from a pretrained 3D model to recover the corresponding camera trajectories. Model stitching maps the generator's predicted latents directly into the estimator's intermediate feature space, bypassing RGB decoding. This decomposition allows task knowledge to expand through broad human and robot video data while reusing geometric motion estimation across tasks and embodiments. The resulting pose estimator transfers across Franka Panda, PiPER-X, and Galaxea R1 Pro without further fine-tuning. Across tabletop and laundry-room settings, WVP generalizes to tasks ranging from precise grasping and inserting to handling deformable objects, achieving a success rate of over 50% in zero-shot out-of-distribution evaluations. Our project page is at https://wrist-video-policy.github.io.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 作为通用机器人政策的 Wrist-Camera 视频传播
articles.content_zh: 通用的操纵政策应执行新的任务,在不熟悉的场景中运作,在机器人的身上传授技能。 我们提出Wrist Video Policy(WVP),这是一个闭路操纵框架,它学习如何通过视频预测进行操纵,并通过几何估计恢复可执行的运动. 我们的关键想法是通过手腕-相机轨迹来代表机器人运动,通过固定的手眼转变来决定相应的末端效应器. 我们把一个预测未来腕部视图的视频生成器与从预先训练的3D模型中改编的姿势估计器配对,以恢复相应的相机轨迹. 模型将生成器的预测潜伏物直接缝合到估计器的中间特征空间,绕过RGB解码. 这种分解使得任务知识能够通过广泛的人和机器人视频数据扩展,同时重新使用跨任务和浮雕的几何运动估计. 由此形成的构型是Franca Panda,PiPER-X,以及Galaxea R1 Pro的互换,无需进一步微调. 跨台式和洗衣房设置,WVP概括到从精确抓取和插入到处理可变形物体的任务,在零射出分配评价中成功率超过50%. 我们的项目网页见https://wrist-video-policy.github.io。

articles.title: UMAMI: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset for Evidence-Grounded Dietary Decisions
articles.content: Dietary decisions require identifying a food's nutrient content and considering individual dietary needs, but recognizing food from an image alone does not provide this information. Visually similar foods can have different nutrient profiles, so selecting the wrong food record can lead to incorrect decisions even when nutrient rules are applied correctly. Furthermore, satisfying nutrient constraints does not necessarily establish a food's relevance to a person's intake. Evaluating these challenges together requires connecting food images, nutrient records, and individual intake histories. To support this evaluation, we introduce UMAMI (Unified Multimodal Assessment of Meals and Intake), a multimodal dataset and benchmark linking independently collected food images with nutrient profiles and respondent health and intake records. Using this dataset, we construct three diagnostic tasks covering visual nutrient question answering, personalized food recommendation, and condition-aware food substitution. Paired instances and input controls examine how visual identity and respondent context affect decisions. Our experiments identify errors in both food-record selection and nutrient-rule application, while showing that higher rule compliance does not necessarily improve alignment with subsequent recorded intake. These findings highlight the need to evaluate how multimodal systems select and use structured evidence for dietary decisions. The dataset, code, and dashboard are available at https://umami-benchmark.github.io.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: UMAMI: 证据组合饮食决定的多式联运基准数据集
articles.content_zh: 饮食决定要求确定食物的营养含量和考虑个人的饮食需求,但仅从形象上确认食物并不能提供这种信息。 视觉上相似的食物可以有不同的营养素特征,因此选择错误的食物记录会导致错误的决定,即使营养素规则得到正确应用. 此外,满足营养限制并不一定确定食物与个人摄入量的相关性。 要共同评估这些挑战,就必须将食物图像、营养记录和个人摄入历史联系起来。 为支持这一评估,我们采用了UMAMI(膳食和摄入量统一多式联运评估),这是一个将独立收集的食品图像与营养素剖面和应答健康和摄入量记录联系起来的多式联运数据集和基准。 利用这个数据集,我们构建了三个诊断任务,包括视觉营养素问题回答,个性化食品推荐,以及状况感知食品替代. Paired实例和输入控制审查视觉身份和被申请人的背景如何影响决定。 我们的实验发现在食品记录选择和营养规则应用中都存在错误,同时表明遵守更高的规则并不一定能改善与随后记录的摄入量的一致性. 这些调查结果突出表明,需要评价多模式系统如何选择和使用结构化证据进行饮食决策。 数据集、代码和仪表板见https://umami-benchmark.github.io。

articles.title: RoFE: Rotated Frozen Embeddings for Low-Data Multimodal Tabular Learning
articles.content: Multimodal tabular learning combines tabular data with images and text, often in settings where labeled data are scarce. Tabular foundation models such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) offer a promising solution via in-context learning without task-specific training. However, modern image and text encoders produce embeddings with hundreds or thousands of dimensions, far exceeding the number of features encountered during PFN pretraining. Existing approaches bridge this gap using principal component analysis (PCA) to compress frozen embeddings. Surprisingly, we find that this PCA interface can underperform simple linear classifiers when labeled examples are scarce, even though PFNs are designed for small datasets. We identify the underlying failure mechanism: the PFN's per-column standardization removes the variances of the PCA scores. When the PCA keeps every direction of the labeled examples, the examples collapse into a regular simplex in which all pairwise distances are equal. To address this problem, we propose Rotated Frozen Embeddings (RoFE), a training-free method that rotates PCA scores before PFN inference. We theoretically show that rotation makes the column variances nearly equal, so that standardization approximately preserves the embedding geometry. Across image and text classification tasks, encoders, and tabular foundation models, RoFE improves low-data performance over the PCA interface and outperforms baselines that require task-specific training. The improvements also extend to regression.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RoFE: 低数据多种模式学习的旋转冷冻嵌入
articles.content_zh: 多式联运表征学习将表征数据与图像和文本相结合,往往在标签数据稀缺的环境下进行. 表格基础模型,如以前安装的数据网络,通过不进行具体任务培训的内文学习,提供了一个有希望的解决办法。 然而,现代的图像和文本编码器产生嵌入式,具有数百或数千个维度,远远超过PFN预训过程中遇到的特性数量. 现有方法利用主要组件分析来压缩冷冻嵌入物来弥补这一差距。 令人惊讶的是,我们发现,这个PCA接口在标签上的例子很少时,可能无法很好地表现简单的线性分类器,尽管PFN是为小数据集设计的. 我们确定潜在的失败机制:PFN的每栏标准化消除了PCA分数的差异. 当五氯苯甲醚保持标签示例的每一个方向时,示例会崩溃成一个普通的简单x,其中所有双向距离是相等的. 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用旋转冻嵌入法(ROFE),这是一种在PFN推论前旋转PCA分数的无训练方法. 我们理论上表明,旋转使列差异几乎相等,因此标准化大约可以保留嵌入几何. 在整个图像和文本分类任务、编码器和表格基础模型中,RoFE在PCA接口上改进了低数据性能,并超越了需要具体任务培训的基线。 改进范围还包括倒退。

articles.title: Distill the Correction, Not the Rewrite: Hindsight Twins for Self-Improving Text-to-Image Models
articles.content: Text-to-image models can learn from their own mistakes by distilling a self-teacher conditioned on a vision-language critic's revised prompt. However, such self-teachers barely improve alignment, and both they and their hindsight-contrast variants absorb the critic's unintended additions to the scene, such as lighting or scenery. We attribute this to two factors: (1) the prompt already specifies the desired fix, so a useful revision must go beyond the failed span, often rewriting the entire scene and adding details that overshadow the fix; (2) although the critic localizes the error to a single span, self-teachers condition on the rewrite, entangling the intended fix with unintended additions. Motivated by these insights, we propose Hindsight Twins (HinT), which fills the critic's revision template once with the intended fix and once with the observed error and distills only their velocity difference, anchored at the user's prompt. Because text encoders spread the edit of a single slot to all other tokens, HinT further aligns the twins' token states outside the slot. Across Qwen-Image-2512, SD3.5-M, and FLUX.2-klein, HinT keeps the rate of critic-induced bias at the base-model level while matching or exceeding the alignment gains of prior self-distillation, and it keeps improving over twelve rounds of self-training where contrastive baselines decay.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 扭曲的校正, 不重写: 用于自改进文本到图像模型的平视双胞胎
articles.content_zh: 文本到图像模型可以通过提炼一个以视觉语言评论家修正的即时性为条件的自师,从自己的错误中吸取教训. 然而,这种自我老师几乎没有改进对齐性,他们和他们的后视-相隔变体都吸收了评论家对场景的意外添加,如照明或风景. 我们将此归因于两个因素:(1)提示已经指定了想要的固定,所以一个有用的修改必须超越失败的跨度,经常重写整个场景,并添加一些使固定蒙上阴影的细节;(2)虽然批评者将错误定位到一个跨度,但自我老师在重写上的条件,用意想不到的添加来将预定的固定包围起来. 在这些见解的激励下,我们提出Hindsight Twins(HinT),它让评论家的审校模板一次充满了预期的固定,一次充满了所观察到的误差,并且只蒸馏了他们的速率差异,在用户的迅速下锚. 因为文本编码器将单一插槽的编辑传播到所有其他的符号上,HinT进一步将双胞胎的符号状态比对到槽外. 横跨Quen-Image-2512,SD3.5-M和FLUX.2-Klein, HinT将批评者引发的偏差率保持在基模水平上,同时匹配或超过之前自我消化的对齐收益,并在对比性基线衰减的地方不断改进超过十二轮的自我训练.

articles.title: Déjà VAE: When Do Autoencoder Traces Reveal Generated Images?
articles.content: A latent diffusion model's output has already passed through its autoencoder, so a second round trip changes it very little. This "déjà vu" underlies reconstruction-based detectors of generated images; we analyse when it reveals a generated image and when it does not. Read by a frozen vision foundation model without training, the trace is strongest in intermediate layers, and, unlike pixel-level reconstruction error, it treats blur as a sign of a real image. It belongs to the generator's exact decoder: on Synthbuster, the exact decoders of Stable Diffusion 1.3, 1.4, 2 and XL are the strongest of eight autoencoders and catch 94-100% of their generators' images at a 5% false-alarm rate (SDXL's version identified post hoc), while near-identical versions catch 7-42%. A detector trained only on real photographs and their autoencoder copies matches one trained on 162k generated images on GenImage (+2.3 points, 95% CI [0.9, 3.7]) and complements it in fusion, but one resize with JPEG re-save, or a mild blur, costs it 19-27 points. Two lessons concern benchmarks. The in-the-wild benchmark Chameleon can be solved from image width alone. And on Synthbuster, how the real photographs are matched to the generated images' size decides whether our detector leads or trails (+4.4 or -9.7 points): the matching protocol alone can reverse a detector comparison. Code and per-image scores: https://github.com/iamsaugatpandey/deja-vae

articles.title_zh: Déjà VAE:自动编码器何时追踪启示生成的图像?
articles.content_zh: 一个潜在的扩散模型的输出 已经通过它的自动编码器, 所以第二次往返 改变很少。 这种“déjà vu”是对生成的图像的基于重建的探测器的基础;当它显示生成的图像时,当它不显示时,我们进行分析。 由冷冻的视觉基础模型在没有训练的情况下读取,微量在中间层最强,与像素级重建错误不同,它把模糊作为真实图像的标志. 它属于发电机的精确解码器:在Synthbuster上,Stable Difusion 1.3,1.4,2和XL的精确解码器是8个自动编码器中最强的,以5%的假警报率捕捉到94-100%的发电机图像(SDXL的版本识别后临时),而近同版本捕捉到7-42%. 仅接受过真实照片培训的探测器及其自动编码器副本与接受过162k生成的GenImage图像(+2.3分,95%CI [0.9,3.7])培训的探测器相匹配,并在聚变中加以补充,但一次用JPEG重塑大小,或轻微模糊,花费了19-27分. 两个教训涉及基准。 单从图像宽度就可以解决 " 内在 " 基准变色龙。 而在Synthbuster上,真实照片如何与生成的图像大小匹配,决定我们的探测器是引导还是跟踪(+4.4或-9.7点):匹配协议本身就可以逆转一个探测器的比较. 代码和每个图像的分数:https://github.com/iamsaugatpandey/deja-vae

articles.title: Token Pruning Needs a Protected Sink Token: Coherent Spatial Aggregation in Vision Transformers
articles.content: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are a predominant architecture for computer vision, with token reduction emerging as a popular paradigm to improve their efficiency. Prior work compares reduction algorithms, but not how models respond to them, nor how their response changes with model depth. We propose Monte Carlo Token Pruning (MCTP), which estimates each token's impact on the prediction when tokens are explicitly removed during the forward pass. Applying MCTP to recent pretrained models, we observe that most, such as DINOv3, maintain a similar ranking of token importance at every depth (high Coherent Aggregation), while SigLIP 2 does not. This coherence requires predictions to survive pruning, which depends on keeping high-norm "sink" tokens: prefix tokens are kept by design, while prefix-free SigLIP 2 forms them on patch tokens, which pruning may remove. We show that in removing DINOv3's prefix tokens, its predictions and coherence collapse, while protecting only 5 tokens for SigLIP 2 cuts the token impact outside the object's bounding box by up to 62%. Beyond this, MCTP offers a post-hoc method to evaluate how a pretrained ViT responds to pruning, and suggests that token reduction methods should keep "sinks".

articles.title: WildAnySplat: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild
articles.content:
We present WildAnySplat, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that enables robust novel-view synthesis from in-the-wild multi-view images. Unlike controlled captures, real-world images often contain multi-view inconsistencies caused by transient occluders, illumination changes, and camera ISP, which degrade the quality of existing feed-forward reconstruction methods.
  To address this challenge, we introduce a student-teacher framework that learns transient-robust and appearance-consistent 3D representations. A teacher network operates on clean images, while a student processes the corresponding in-the-wild inputs. The teacher provides clean supervision to guide the student toward a consistent canonical representation. Since paired clean and in-the-wild data are scarce, we use a hybrid data strategy, combining real paired captures, synthetic augmentations, and pseudo-clean labels generated from optimization-based reconstructions, bridging the domain gap between synthetic and real-world data.
  We adopt a transformer architecture with dedicated DPT heads for camera pose, depth, and Gaussian prediction. We additionally predict per-view transient masks to reweight photometric supervision and suppress unreliable Gaussians. To account for cross-view appearance variation, we incorporate a bilateral grid module that models per-image color transformations and enables recovery of a canonical radiance representation.
  Experiments on challenging in-the-wild benchmarks show that WildAnySplat improves robustness to transient occlusions and appearance variation while retaining the fast inference of feed-forward Gaussian Splatting.

articles.title: OmniV-Bench: Can MLLMs Comprehend Immersive Spatio-temporal Scenes?
articles.content: Omnidirectional videos (ODVs) capture dynamic environments with a full $360^\circ$ field of view, providing rich spatial context and temporal dynamics for applications such as virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and embodied intelligence. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made great progress in spatial and temporal understanding, yet their ability to comprehend the immersive 360 spatio-temporal information conveyed by ODVs remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we first introduce OmniV-Bench, a Benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the capabilities of MLLMs on spatio-temporal Omnidirectional Video understanding. OmniV-Bench contains 4,123 high-quality ODVs collected from diverse scenes, along with 8,923 human-annotated question-answer pairs spanning 11 fine-grained tasks across three categories, i.e., general, spatial, and spatio-temporal understanding. Extensive benchmark experiments reveal that the spatio-temporal complexity of ODVs poses significant challenges for current MLLMs. To address these limitations, we further propose OmniV-Harness, an agentic harness that enhances ODV understanding through viewpoint-guided evidence initialization and task-relevant evidence acquisition with adaptive tool use. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that OmniV-Harness consistently improves immersive spatio-temporal reasoning ability of MLLMs. Both OmniV-Bench and OmniV-Harness will be released upon publication.

articles.title: Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
articles.content: Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract. Pretrained vision encoders already capture this information in their latent features, with CLIP linking objects to image regions, DINOv3 matching semantics across views, and VGGT encoding multi-view geometry. However, VLMs do not benefit from these features when we present them directly in context as grayscale feature images. We therefore propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses latent features into explicit spatial evidence for VLMs. In LatentParse, an analyst VLM probes the features of all three encoders with predefined tools that locate objects, track them across views, and measure motion between views. It then distills the results into a concise text report, which is provided together with the images to the VLM to answer the question. We evaluate LatentParse on MMSI-Bench, MV-RoboBench and SPAR-Bench, where it improves all five VLMs over the photo-only baseline by 0.7-2.4 percentage points on average. On MMSI-Bench, it raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.4% to 39.5%, with the largest improvements of 19.2 percentage points on the camera-related questions. These results suggest that latent features become useful for spatial reasoning once they are parsed into relation evidence, without training. Code is available at https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse.

articles.title: Demographic Encoding is Not Exposure: Fairness and Privacy in Chest X-ray Foundation Models
articles.content: Medical foundation models encode patient demographics and can reveal whether a patient was in the training set, and these properties are often treated as one problem. We tested whether they are aligned by measuring demographic encoding, diagnostic fairness gaps and membership-inference vulnerability on the same models. We trained 200 linear or multilayer-perceptron (MLP) heads on frozen BiomedCLIP, DINOv2 and RAD-DINO embeddings, with three seeds, and audited them on CheXpert and NIH ChestX-ray14. Demographic encoding explained almost no variance in patient vulnerability, and all 72 CheXpert associations were statistically equivalent to zero. Erasing linearly decodable demographics left leakage unchanged but reduced age-related underdiagnosis gaps. Leakage depended instead on head capacity and training length. On RAD-DINO, a linear head reached a membership-inference area under the curve (AUC) of 0.694, compared with 0.907 for a 30-epoch MLP, at similar test performance. Fairness and privacy should therefore be audited separately, and linear heads or shorter training reduce leakage with little or no loss of utility. The code is available on GitHub for public use.

articles.title_zh: 人口编码不曝光:胸X光基金会模型中的公平和隐私
articles.content_zh: 医学基础模型将患者人口统计编码,并可以揭示患者是否在训练集中,这些属性往往被当作一个问题处理. 我们通过衡量人口编码、诊断性公平差距以及成员在相同模式上的脆弱性,测试了它们是否一致。 我们在冰冻的BiomedCLIP,DINOv2和RAD-DINO嵌入上训练了200个线性或多层受体(MLP)头,有3个种子,并在CheXpert和NIH ChestX-ray14上对其进行了审计. 人口编码解释了病人脆弱性几乎没有差异,所有72个切斯特协会在统计学上都相当于零。 线性可解码人口结构的缩小使渗漏保持不变,但缩小了与年龄有关的诊断不足差距。 渗漏则取决于头部能力和培训时间长短。 在RAD-DINO上,一个线性头在曲线(AUC)下达到成员推导区0.694,而30世纪的MLP在类似测试性能下则达到0.907. 因此,公平和隐私应分别审计,线性头部或较短的训练减少渗漏,很少或没有丧失效用。 该代码可在GitHub上获取,供公众使用.

articles.title: Reinforcing Diffusion Models by Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching
articles.content: Forward diffusion reinforcement learning (RL)---enabling deterministic ODE sampling without trajectory backpropagation---has grown increasingly popular for efficiently aligning diffusion models. However, we reveal that existing methods essentially rely on signed reward-weighted regression (RWR), regressing the \emph{trainable policy} velocity onto rollouts from a \emph{behavior distribution}. Unbiased baseline subtraction implicitly assumes that the policy velocity equals the behavior marginal velocity---an idealized assumption violated under classifier-free guidance (CFG) rollouts, offline/off-policy updates, and imperfect online self-consistency. This \emph{behavior--policy mismatch} breaks baseline invariance and injects \emph{baseline-induced gradient drift}, destabilizing training. To resolve this issue, we propose \textbf{I}nstantaneous \textbf{T}rajectory \textbf{D}istribution \textbf{M}atching (\textbf{iTDM}), taking the infinitesimal limit of Trajectory Distribution Matching toward a time-local reward-guided target via the posterior-score identity to yield a sample-level gradient anchored at the behavior velocity without learning an additional reward-tilted target score. Tracking this velocity with an online auxiliary denoiser guarantees exact baseline invariance at the auxiliary optimum, effectively suppressing baseline drift across both online and offline RL. Extensive experiments across compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment show that iTDM achieves state-of-the-art in-domain and out-of-domain performance. Notably, on the challenging GenEval2 benchmark, iTDM converges nearly $3\times$ faster than competing methods while scaling smoothly to $0.87$ without collapse. Code is available at https://github.com/Luo-Yihong/iTDM

articles.title: Graph2Scene: Relation-Aware Text-to-Image Generation with Graph-Guided Diffusion Model
articles.content: Text-to-image diffusion models still struggle with complex prompts containing many elements and interactions. Existing attention-control methods mainly focus on controlling where elements appear, but often ignore how objects interact with each other. As a result, relation tokens describing interactions between elements may assign high attention to irrelevant regions, leading to missing or incorrect interactions. In this paper, we propose Graph2Scene, a training-free framework that treats scene graphs as a core control signal for diffusion generation. It represents elements as nodes and their relations as edges, and translates these element-relation dependencies into selective attention guidance. It grounds each element to its corresponding region and guides relational interactions among the involved elements. To achieve appropriate relation control without over-constraining the generation process, Graph2Scene further adapts the control duration to scene complexity and progressively relaxes graph guidance during denoising. Experiments on T2I-CompBench and ConceptMix show clear improvements in compositional generation, especially for object relations. On ConceptMix, Graph2Scene improves relationship accuracy from 0.59 to 0.84 over the strongest FLUX.1-based regional-control baseline. Results on LongBench-T2I further show its advantage on long and complex prompts.

articles.title_zh: 图2 场景: 以图示化的传播模式进行文字到图像生成
articles.content_zh: 文本到图像的传播模型仍然与包含许多元素和相互作用的复杂提示相抗衡. 现有的注意控制方法主要侧重于控制元素出现的地方,但经常忽略物体如何相互作用. 因此,描述各要素之间相互作用的关系符号可能会对不相关的区域给予高度关注,导致相互作用缺失或不正确。 在本文中,我们提出Graph2Scene,一个将场景图作为扩散生成核心控制信号的无培训框架. 它代表着作为节点的元素及其作为边缘的关系,并将这些元素关系依赖性转化为选择性的注意指导. 它将每个要素作为其相应区域的依据,并指导相关要素之间的关系互动。 为了在不过度限制生成过程的情况下实现适当的关系控制,Graph2Scene进一步调整了控制时间以适应场景的复杂性,并在解密时逐渐放松图表指导. 在T2I-CompBench和ConceptMix上的实验显示在组成生成方面有明显的改进,特别是在对象关系方面. 关于ConceptMix,Graph2Scene将关系精度从0.59提高到0.84,高于最强的FLUX.1区域控制基线. 关于Long Bench-T2I的结果进一步显示了它对长而复杂的提示的优势.

articles.title: Foresight Forcing: Learning Spatial Foresight for Robotic Manipulation
articles.content: Robotic manipulation policies can improve action prediction by anticipating how objects move and how their spatial relationships change. World Action Models (WAMs) learn to predict future visual observations, but their training objectives typically leave the underlying 3D geometric transitions implicit. To alleviate this problem, we introduce Foresight Forcing ($\mathcal{F}^{2}$), a WAM that learns a spatial transition representation from changes in a pretrained 3D feature space. During training, a frozen 3D foundation model extracts patch-wise feature differences from aligned current and future observations that provide dense supervision for geometry-aware feature transitions. We distill these targets into spatial transition queries, which are progressively refined from the current observation, language instruction, and proprioceptive state, and use them alongside current visual features to generate actions. At deployment, the policy predicts the queries without future observations or the 3D teacher. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin2.0 demonstrate strong manipulation performance and improved robustness, including 95.01% average success on RoboTwin2.0 Full. On six real-world manipulation tasks, $\mathcal{F}^{2}$ achieves a mean task score of 85.8%.

articles.title_zh: 前瞻前瞻:学习机器人操纵空间前瞻
articles.content_zh: 机器人操纵政策可以通过预测物体如何移动及其空间关系的变化来改进动作预测. 世界行动模型(WAMS)学习预测未来的视觉观测,但其培训目标通常会暗含基本的3D几何过渡. 为了缓解这个问题,我们引入了Foresight Forcing (\ mathcal{F}^{2}$),这是一个从预先训练的3D特性空间的变化中学习空间过渡表现的WAM. 在训练期间,一个冷冻的3D基础模型从对齐的当前和未来的观测中提取出补丁式特征差异,为几何感知特征过渡提供密集的监管. 我们把这些目标提炼成空间过渡查询,这些查询从目前的观测、语言教学和自主状态逐步完善,并结合目前的视觉特征加以利用,以产生行动。 部署时,政策预测询问时没有未来观察或3D老师. 关于LIBERO,LIBERO-Plus,和RoboTwin2.0的实验表现出强大的操纵性能和增强的稳健性,包括RoboTwin2.0 Full上95.01%的平均成功率. 在六个现实世界操纵任务上,$\ mathcal{F}^{2}$实现85.8%的平均任务分.

articles.title: Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents
articles.content: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet their evaluation remains largely static. Existing benchmarks provide a strong foundation, but fixed difficulty ceilings, limited feature coverage, and coarse aggregate scores progressively weaken their discriminative and diagnostic value. We introduce CUA-SEE, a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers from rollout evidence. It disentangles three objectives: benchmark evolution expands evaluation scope through cohort-calibrated difficulty and coverage growth; diagnostic evolution increases resolution through agent-conditional capability-boundary probes; and verifier evolution improves precision by translating changing requirements into state-grounded checkpoints with adversarial validation. Across multiple agents, applications, and rounds, CUA-SEE generates challenging, measurable tasks while preserving process-level evidence. Our results position adaptive evaluation as a scalable counterpart to self-evolving agents, continuously tracking what agents can do, where their boundaries lie, and how reliably progress is measured.

articles.title_zh: 计算机使用代理工具的自演评价环境
articles.content_zh: 计算机使用代理人(CUAs)正在迅速改进,但其评价基本上保持不变。 现有基准提供了坚实的基础,但有固定的困难上限、有限的特征覆盖面和粗糙的总分逐渐削弱了其歧视性和诊断性价值。 我们引入了CUA-SEE,这是一种封闭式评估环境,它共同将任务和可执行核查人从推出的证据中演化出来. 它分解了三个目标:基准演化通过组群校准难度和覆盖面增长来扩大评价范围;诊断演化通过代理-有条件的能力边界探测器来提高分辨率;核查演化通过将不断变化的要求转化为有对抗性的基于国家的检查站来提高精度。 CUA-SEE通过多种代理、应用和回合,产生具有挑战性、可计量的任务,同时保存流程层面的证据。 我们的成果将适应性评价定位为可扩展的自我演化剂的对应物,不断跟踪哪些物剂可以做,其界限在什么地方,如何可靠地衡量进展.

articles.title: Diffutoon-2: Toon Shading with Video Diffusion Models
articles.content: Toon shading renders objects with a flat, stylized appearance. Diffusion models open a new route to this task by transforming photorealistic videos into an anime style. However, existing approaches often rely on curated source and style training pairs or additional visual references. Diffutoon avoids these requirements through structure guidance and colorization, but builds on an image diffusion backbone with short-window motion modules and repeated overlapping-window denoising. We present Diffutoon-2, a video diffusion framework that learns toon shading through animation reconstruction. Two complementary modules independently reconstruct animation clips from outlines and blurred colors, with the video backbone frozen. At inference, the modules jointly guide generation using the same types of conditions extracted from photorealistic footage, requiring neither cross-domain training pairs nor external style references. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Diffutoon-2 outperforms both general-purpose and domain-specific baselines, across quantitative metrics and human evaluation.

articles.title_zh: Diffutoon-2:带视频传播模型的卡通
articles.content_zh: 托恩阴影使物体具有平坦的,结构化的外观. 扩散模型通过将光现实主义视频转化为动漫风格,打开了实现这项任务的新途径. 然而,现有方法往往依赖精密的源头和风格培训对联或额外的视觉参考。 Diffutoon通过结构引导和色化避免了这些要求,但以图像传播主干为基础,有短窗运动模块和重复的重叠窗口去诺化. 我们提出Diffutoon 2, 一个通过动画重建学习卡通阴影的视频传播框架。 两个互补模块独立地从轮廓和模糊的颜色重建动画片段,视频主干部分被冻结. 推论,模块使用从光现实主义镜头中提取的相同类型条件共同引导生成,不需要跨域培训对称或外部风格参考. 广泛的实验表明,Diffutoon-2在定量计量和人类评价方面都优于普通用途和特定领域基线。

articles.title: SIAMBA: A Pseudo-Siamese Mamba-based Deep Learning Network for Multimodal Flood Change Detection
articles.content: Flood change detection from bi-temporal multispectral and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images is essential for rapid disaster response. In this context, Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery provides discriminative spectral observations, whereas Sentinel-1 SAR provides weather-independent structural information. Using these modalities jointly requires modelling temporal evidence while accounting for cross-modal heterogeneity. In particular, change detection is complicated by cloud contamination, illumination variability, acquisition geometry and speckle, and heterogeneous land-cover responses. To address these challenges, we propose SIAMBA, a pseudo-siamese Mamba-based network for bi-temporal flood change detection from paired Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 observations. SIAMBA uses dedicated modality-specific encoders with dual-pooling squeeze-and-excitation recalibration and selective state-space processing for long-range spatial context. A gated cross-modal change module derives absolute, signed, and relative log-ratio differences at multiple semantic levels, and attention-refined skip connections support progressive multi-scale decoding. Experiments are carried out on OMBRIA benchmark, which includes an independent test set and geographically diverse subsets in France, Albania, Guyana, and Timor. SIAMBA achieves 81.98% IoU, and 93.57% OA on the independent test set, reaching the highest values in the considered comparison. It also provides the highest unweighted average IoU and OA across four regional subsets spatially disjuncted. These results indicate that combining selective state-space contextual modelling with gated multiscale discrepancy learning effectively improves flood change mapping across the evaluated geographic settings.

articles.title_zh: SIAMBA:一个基于Pseudo-Siamense Mamba的多模式洪水变化探测深度学习网络
articles.content_zh: 从双时段多光谱和合成孔径雷达(SAR)图像中发现洪水变化对快速救灾至关重要。 在这方面,Sentinel-2多光谱图象提供不同的光谱观测,而Sentinel-1 SAR则提供天气独立的结构信息. 联合使用这些模式需要模拟时间证据,同时考虑跨模式异质性。 特别是,云层污染、照明变异、获取几何和光谱,以及不同的土地覆盖反应使变化探测变得复杂。 为了应付这些挑战,我们建议SIAMBA,一个伪暹罗曼巴网络,从配对的哨兵1号和哨兵2号观测中进行双时洪灾变化探测. SIAMBA使用专用模式专用编码器,并具有双聚式挤压和激发重排以及选择性的状态空间处理,用于远程空间上下文. 一个有门的跨模式变化模块在多个语义层面获得绝对,签名,和相对的log-ratio差异,注意-精细的跳过连接支持渐进的多尺度解码. 在OMBRIA基准上进行了实验,其中包括法国、阿尔巴尼亚、圭亚那和帝汶的独立测试集和地域多样性的子集。 SIAMBA在独立测试集上实现了81.98%的IoU,93.57%的OA,在经过深思熟虑的比较中达到了最高值. 它还为四个区域子集提供了空间脱钩的未加权平均IoU和OA。 这些结果表明,选择性的状态-空间背景建模与有门的多尺度差异学习相结合,有效地改进了所评价地理环境中的洪水变化绘图。

articles.title: FGSCalib: Targetless Camera-LiDAR Extrinsic Calibration from Foreground Segmentation
articles.content: Camera-LiDAR pairs installed as fixed infrastructure need periodic recalibration, but a calibration target takes the installation out of service. We present FGSCalib, a targetless method that calibrates a stationary camera-LiDAR pair from the objects moving in its view. We only assume that arbitrary moving objects are present in the scene: each sensor separates the moving foreground from the static background, without relying on object classes. With the correct extrinsic, the LiDAR foreground points project onto the camera foreground. FGSCalib turns the camera mask into a boundary-proximity field and finds the extrinsic by two-stage simulated annealing over selected frame pairs. It needs no measured initial extrinsic (random starts give similar results) and works with both rotating and non-repetitive LiDARs. We evaluate it on 21 simulated scenarios with exact ground truth and on 72 real ones (nine camera-LiDAR pairs in eight scenes), with a reference averaged from 43 manual calibrations. In simulation the median error is 5.3 cm and 0.19°. On real data we use a tolerance of 18 cm and 1.8°, met by 93% of single manual calibrations. Keeping the lowest-cost of five runs, FGSCalib meets it in 51 of the 72 scenarios: in 20 of 24 with the Livox, where the strongest of five baselines reaches 11, and in 31 of 48 with the two rotating LiDARs, where only one baseline estimate does. Its median error is 9.5 cm and 0.9°, against 7.3 cm and 0.7° for a single manual calibration. The code and the dataset are available online.

articles.title_zh: FGSCalib:无目标照相机-LiDAR 来自前景分区的外部校正
articles.content_zh: 作为固定基础设施安装的相机-LiDAR配对需要定期重新校准,但校准目标使安装失去服务. 我们提出FGSCalib,一种无目标方法,从它视线中移动的物体校准一对固定相机-LiDAR对. 我们只假设场景中存在任意移动的物体:每个传感器将移动的前缘与静态背景分开,而不依赖于物体类. 有了正确的外观,LiDAR前缘点工程在镜头前缘. FGSCalib将相机遮罩转换成边界近似场,通过在选定的帧对上进行两阶段模拟反射来发现外星. 它不需要经过测量的初始外部(随机开始产生类似的结果),并与旋转和非重复的LiDARs合作。 我们用21个模拟场景和72个真实场景(8个场景中的9个相机-LiDAR对)来评价它,从43个手动校准中得出参考平均值. 在模拟中位误差为5.3厘米和0.19°. 在真实数据上,我们使用18厘米和1.8°的耐受度,得到93%的单手校准。 FGSCalib保持5次运行的最低成本,在72次假设中的51次:24次运行中的20次运行中,5次基线中最强者达到11次运行中,48次运行中的31次运行中,2次运行中,只有一次基线估计。 其中位误差为9.5cm和0.9°,而单手校准误差为7.3cm和0.7°. 代码和数据集可在线查阅.

articles.title: CHICO: Bridging Sparse Metadata and Multimodal Evidence in Cultural Heritage Collections
articles.content: Cultural heritage aggregators provide access to millions of digitized items. Yet their catalog records often contain sparse, heterogeneous metadata, with associated media links that may not lead to accessible images. Structuring and validating these resources for multimodal AI research can support reproducible experimentation. To this end, we present CHICO (Cultural Heritage Images and Catalog Objects), a multimodal dataset derived from Europeana that brings together curated catalog fields, images, and contextual information to support evidence-grounded description generation while retaining the original Europeana records. It comprises more than 60,000 cultural heritage records with associated images. Although originally developed for that purpose, it can also support multimodal information retrieval, metadata enrichment, and evidence-based evaluation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CHICO: 文化遗产收藏中弥合碎片元数据和多式联运证据
articles.content_zh: 文化遗产集合器提供数百万个数字化物品。 然而,它们的目录记录往往包含稀少、内容繁杂的元数据,而与之相关的媒体链接可能无法获取图像。 为多式人工智能研究寻找和验证这些资源,可以支持可复制的实验。 为此,我们提出CHICO(文化遗产图像和目录对象),这是一个从欧洲a 衍生出来的多模式数据集,汇集了整理的目录域,图像,以及背景信息,以支持基于证据的描述生成,同时保留欧洲a原始记录. 它包括6万多份文化遗产记录以及相关的图像. 虽然它最初是为了这一目的开发的,但它也可以支持多式联运信息检索、元数据丰富和循证评价。

articles.title: CoSel: Cooperation as Selection for End-to-End Driving
articles.content: Cooperative driving can extend a vehicle's awareness beyond its own sensors, but existing cooperative end-to-end methods inject shared information into the planner and rely on cooperative driving demonstrations to learn how to use it. The moments in which shared information should change a driving decision are rare in such data, providing limited supervision for learning this behavior. We argue that cooperation need not be learned by the planner. Instead, reacting to shared information requires predicting how surrounding agents will move and selecting a response from the candidate trajectories of an ego planner. We introduce CoSel, a cooperation-as-selection framework that leaves the planner and its ego-only input unchanged. A separately trained cooperative predictor uses observations from the ego vehicle, roadside units, and connected automated vehicles to predict surrounding agents and their future motion. CoSel evaluates the planner's candidate trajectories against these predictions, preserves the planner's choice when it remains safe, and selects the closest safe alternative when shared information reveals additional risk. Each safety intervention is traceable to the shared evidence that triggers it. In closed-loop evaluation, CoSel achieves a driving score of 70.7 on V2Xverse, outperforming the best compared cooperative method by 7.5 points, and the highest average driving score of 85.8 on MDrive. Under missing ego detections, the collision count of CoSel increases only from 17 to 19 in 72 scenarios, compared with 19 to 32 for an existing cooperative end-to-end model.
