articles.title_zh: CoSel: 合作选择端到端驱动
articles.content_zh: 合作驾驶可以将车辆的意识扩展至自身传感器之外,但现有的合作端对端方法向规划者注入共享信息,并依靠合作驾驶演示学习如何使用. 共享信息改变驱动决定的时刻在这类数据中很少见,对学习这种行为的监督有限。 我们主张,规划者不必学习合作。 相反,对共享信息作出反应需要预测周围的代理人将如何移动,并从自我规划者的候选轨迹中选择反应。 我们提出CoSel,一个合作-即选框架,使规划者及其只自我投入保持不变。 一个接受过单独训练的合作预测器使用来自自负车,路边单元的观测,以及连接的自动车辆来预测周围的物剂及其未来的运动. CoSel对照这些预测来评价规划者候选人的轨迹,保留规划者在保持安全时的选择,并在共享信息揭示额外风险时选择最接近的安全替代品. 每一次安全干预都可以追踪到触发它的共同证据. 在闭路评价中,CoSel在V2Xverse上达到70.7的驾驶分数,以7.5分的成绩优于最佳比较合作方法,在MDrive上达到85.8分的最高平均驾驶分数. 在缺失的自我探测下,CoSel的碰撞计数在72个假想中仅从17个增加到19个,而现有的合作端对端模型则从19个增加到32个.

articles.title: Do Waste Classifiers Recognise Items They Have Never Seen? Object-Disjoint Evaluation on Household and Medical Waste
articles.content: Automatic waste classification supports source separation, which enables recycling and keeps hazardous medical items out of household waste. Waste classification studies often report near-perfect accuracy on random image splits, which put photographs of one item in both training and test sets. To measure how well classifiers recognise items they have never seen, we built BanglaWaste-23, with 4,160 images of 172 objects in 23 household and medical waste classes from Bangladesh. Every image also records which physical item it shows. We evaluated 11 ImageNet-pretrained models and two models trained from scratch (a compact custom network and MobileNetV3-L) using object-disjoint five-fold cross-validation and a random split. On unseen objects, the best pretrained model reached a macro-averaged F1 score of 98.8%, and six models were statistically tied. The random split overstated from-scratch accuracy by 15 to 19 percentage points. The from-scratch models also missed 11 to 13% of medical items, against under 1% for pretrained models. On a second dataset from Dhaka, pretrained accuracy fell by 15 to 22 points. Classifiers should therefore be evaluated on unseen objects, with random-split results read as an upper bound. The data are on Zenodo and the code at https://github.com/saadbaust/BanglaWaste-23.

articles.title_zh: 废物分类者是否认识到从未见过的物品? 关于家庭和医疗废物的客观-不联合评价
articles.content_zh: 废物自动分类支持源头分离,从而能够回收和使危险医疗物品远离家庭废物。 废物分类研究经常在随机图像分割上报告近乎完美的准确性,这把一个物品的照片放在培训和测试集中. 为了衡量分类人员如何识别从未见过的物品,我们建造了BanglaWaste-23,在来自孟加拉国的23个家庭和医疗废物类别中有4,160幅172件物品的图像。 每个图像还记录它显示的物理物品. 我们评估了11个ImageNet预先训练的模型和两个从零开始训练的模型(一个紧凑的定制网络和MobileNetV3-L),使用对象脱节的5倍交叉验证和随机的分割. 在隐形物体上,最好的预训模型达到了宏观平均F1的98.8%的分数,有6个模型在统计上捆绑. 随机从切片精度中多报15至19个百分点. 切除模型也漏掉了11%至13%的医疗物品,而预训模型的误差不到1%。 在来自达卡的第二个数据集中,预训精度下降了15至22分. 因此,分类器应在看不见的物体上加以评价,随机分解的结果应读作上限。 有关数据见Zenodo和代码https://github.com/saadbaust/BanglaWaste-23。

articles.title: Replay Before You Reply: Second-Look Prompting for Unified Multimodal Encoding
articles.content: Solving multimodal tasks requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to form a unified understanding of the image and the question text. However, under causal attention in current VLMs, a token can attend only to what precedes it. Whichever modality comes first is therefore encoded under partial observation of the input, uninformed by the rest of the multimodal context. We introduce Second-Look Prompting (SLP), a training-free method that repeats the image-question pair in the input. In the repeated copy, every visual and textual token can attend to the complete input, yielding a unified multimodal encoding of the pair. Moreover, the added visual tokens contribute computation beyond re-exposing the image: even a blank image in their place can improve reasoning. Across 12 benchmarks, SLP improves the overall average score of every evaluated model, spanning nine open-source models (3B-72B) and three proprietary frontier models, with gains reaching 5.6 points for Gemini 3 Flash on MATH-Vision. Our analysis reveals two complementary mechanisms: the question guides where the second image attends, and the added visual tokens act as a prefill scratchpad whose hidden states retain answer-relevant information from the image and question. These findings highlight input presentation as a simple yet effective way to improve VLM performance.

articles.title_zh: 在您回复前重放 : 二目提示统一多式联运编码
articles.content_zh: 解决多式联运任务需要Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)对图像和问题文本形成统一的理解. 然而,根据目前的自愿终止措施的因果关注,一个符号只能处理它之前的事情。 因此,无论哪一种方式最先出现,都是在部分观察输入的情况下编码的,其他多式联运上下文对此不知情。 我们引入了“二次视觉提示”(SLP),这是一种在输入中重复图像问题对的无训练方法。 在重复的拷贝中,每个视觉和文字符号都可以关注完整的输入,产生一个对对的统一的多式联运编码. 此外,新增的视觉符号除了重新曝光图像之外,还有助于计算:即使是空白图像在它们的位置上也能改进推理. 在12个基准中,SLP改进了每个被评价模型的总平均分,跨越9个开源模型(3B-72B)和3个专有前沿模型,在MATH-Vision上双子座3 Flash的得分达到5.6分. 我们的分析揭示了两个互补的机制:第二个图像所在的问题指南,以及添加的视觉符号充当一个预填抓图,其隐藏状态保留了图像和问题中与答案有关的信息。 这些结论强调,投入列报是改进自愿和半自动交易性能的简单而有效的方法。

articles.title: DexLatentWorld: 3D Cross-Embodiment Latent Action World Models for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation
articles.content: World models facilitate planning and control in robotic manipulation by enabling agents to anticipate the consequences of their actions. However, they typically rely on action-labelled interaction data that is costly to acquire and difficult to scale. These models are also often tied to the specific embodiment they were trained on, limiting transferability to previously unseen robot morphologies. We introduce a 3D latent-action world model that learns continuous action representations directly from point-cloud observations of retargeted human manipulation demonstrations. A contrastive objective is used to encourage consistent representations of motion across embodiments. The resulting unified latent action space serves directly as the search space for model-predictive control, where sampled latent actions condition particle-based future predictions. Executable robot commands are then recovered from the predicted geometric motion without requiring an embodiment-specific action decoder. Through extensive evaluations, we demonstrate that the learned latent actions exhibit controllable and compositional motion, transfer to unseen robot embodiments, and support zero-shot manipulation with unseen gripper geometries. Following task-agnostic adaptation, our model achieves 90%, 92%, and 60% success on reaching, grasping, and placing, respectively, compared with DexWM's reported 72%, 58%, and 28%. Finally, we demonstrate zero-shot real-world manipulation with an unseen dexterous hand, achieving an 86% success rate across 50 trials on five diverse tasks involving pushing, grasping, and lifting everyday objects. These results highlight the potential of geometry-grounded latent actions as a unified, transferable interface for world-model-based robotic manipulation. Project materials, including demonstration videos and source code, are available at https://vinaymohan0409.github.io/DexLatentWorld/.

articles.title_zh: DexLatent World: 3D 零热机器人操纵三维跨Embodiment 慢动作世界模型
articles.content_zh: 世界模式通过使代理人能够预见其行动的后果,促进机器人操纵的规划和控制。 然而,它们通常依赖以行动标记的相互作用数据,这些数据成本高昂,难以衡量。 这些模型还常常与它们所训练的具体化身有关,将可转移性限制在以前看不见的机器人形态上。 我们采用3D潜在行动世界模式,直接从重新瞄准人类操纵示威的点云观测中学习持续行动表现。 采用对比性目标鼓励始终如一地表达各种表现的运动。 由此产生的统一潜在行动空间直接作为模型预测控制搜索空间,在其中取样潜在行动是粒子未来预测的条件。 然后从预测的几何运动中恢复可执行的机器人指令,而不需要一个特制的浮雕动作解码器. 通过广泛的评估,我们证明,所学到的潜在行动显示出可控的和构成的动作,向看不见的机器人的化身转移,以及支持用看不见的握手几何进行零镜头操纵。 在任务不可知的适应之后,我们的模式分别实现了90%、92%和60%的实现率,而DexWM报告的成功率分别为72%、58%和28%。 最后,我们用隐秘的狡猾的手来展示零射现实世界的操控,在50次试验中取得了86%的成功率,这些试验涉及五个不同的任务,包括推、抓住和举起日常物品。 这些成果突出了几何基础潜伏行动作为世界模型机器人操纵的统一,可转移的接口的潜力. 项目材料,包括演示录像和源代码,可查阅https://vinaymohan0409.github.io/DexLatentWorld/。

articles.title: GlanceNav: Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation with Streaming Memory and Counterfactual Rewind
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong policies for vision-and-language navigation (VLN). However, most of them encode a sample of past frames again at every decision and are trained on isolated decisions, so computation is redundant and the usable history is short. They also learn from their own mistakes through outcome rewards that give one scalar to a whole episode. We ask whether a navigator can encode each frame only once, at a constant cost per step, and still remember what matters and learn efficiently from its mistakes. We present GlanceNav, a streaming navigator built on a hybrid MLLM. Its Gated DeltaNet layers carry a recurrent state through the whole episode, while its attention layers keep a short window of recent observations and a small bank of keyframes, selected by how much each frame changes the recurrent state. This constant-size memory keeps the cost per step fixed and allows training on whole episodes with the same memory as at inference. Because the entire memory can also be copied in constant time, we further propose Counterfactual Rewind (CoRe), a reinforcement learning stage that rewinds a drifting rollout to its closest approach to the goal, lets an expert correct a few actions, and credits decisions by the resulting change in outcome. Trained only on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE training splits, with 1,000 instructions for reinforcement learning, a 4B GlanceNav reaches success rates of 71.9% and 73.6% on R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen. On R2R-CE, it outperforms the strongest previous single-RGB method trained without external data by 9.1 points, while running at 104 ms per step.

articles.title_zh: GlanceNav:具有流传内存和反事实倒带的高效视野和语言导航
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)已成为视觉和语言导航的有力政策。 然而,它们大多在每次决定时再次编码一个过去帧的样本,并接受过孤立决定的培训,因此计算是多余的,可用的历史很短. 他们还通过结果奖励从自己的错误中吸取教训,结果奖励给整个剧集一个分级. 我们问一个导航员是否可以只编码每个帧一次,每步费用不变,并且仍然记得什么很重要,并从错误中有效地吸取教训. 我们介绍GlanceNav, 一个流线导航器 建立在混合MLLM上。 它的Gated DeltaNet层通过整个剧集承载一个经常状态,而它的注意力层则保留着一个短窗口来记录最近的观测结果和一个小的密钥框库,根据每个帧对经常状态的改变多少来选择. 这种恒定大小的内存保持每步成本固定,并允许以与推论相同的内存对整个剧集进行培训. 由于整个内存也可以在恒定时间内复制,我们进一步提出反事实倒转(CoRe),这个强化的学习阶段将漂移的展开倒向最接近目标的方法,让一位专家纠正一些行动,并通过由此产生的结果变化来信用决定. 仅在R2R-CE和RxR-CE的训练中进行训练,有1000个强化学习指令,4B GlanceNav在R2R-CE和RxR-CE val-unseen上成功率分别达到71.9%和73.6%. 在R2R-CE上,它比以往在没有外部数据的情况下训练的最强的单RGB方法的成绩高出9.1分,同时每步运行104ms.

articles.title: World Models as Native Latent Action Models
articles.content: Large and diverse video sources, such as egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot recordings, carry rich dynamics but come either without actions or without a shared action space. Latent action models (LAMs) can recover these dynamics, but they train their inverse- and forward-dynamics models (IDM, FDM) from scratch, trading off pixel reconstruction against latent capacity and accuracy. Pretrained video world models natively generate high-fidelity dynamics, yet represent them densely, entangled across all layers. Viewing the world model as a LAM, we show that these dynamics can be extracted with minimal changes to the model. Native LAM operates one pretrained video diffusion transformer as both IDM and FDM, with learnable dynamics registers as the only causal bridge between the two, and trains on counterfactual temporal pairs that differ in motion alone, so that the registers distill a video's dynamics into a compact native latent action. We further propose a pretraining paradigm for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, Pretraining Actions from World models (PAWlicy), in which Native LAM serves as a dynamics teacher on large-scale video; unlike world action models, it never generates video. Native latent actions outperform existing LAMs on the LARY benchmark in both action classification and control regression, and replay the same motion on new robots, in new scenes, and from human hands to robots, although no transfer objective is used in training. With a 3.8B model, PAWlicy reaches a 93.6% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 trained with domain-randomized demonstrations, the highest among VLAs. On RoboDojo, it is competitive on every dimension we evaluate, and its Precision, evaluated by us, is on par with the leading leaderboard entries. On real robots, it improves over the pi_0.5 baseline on both tasks. Both stages use only public data and a publicly released world model.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 世界模范作为土著晚期行动模范
articles.content_zh: 大型和多样化的视频来源,例如以自我为中心的人类视频和多样的机器人录音,具有丰富的动态,但要么没有行动,要么没有共享的行动空间。 慢动模型(LAMs)可以恢复这些动力学,但它们从零开始训练其逆动和前动模型(IDM,FDM),将像素重建与潜在能力和准确性进行交易. 预先训练的视频世界模型在本土产生高真实度的动态,然而却代表它们密集,缠绕在各个层次. 将世界模型视为一个LAM,我们显示这些动力学可以用对模型的最小变化来提取. 原生LAM作为IDM和FDM都运行一个经过预先训练的视频传播变压器,可学习的动态记录器是两者之间唯一的因果桥梁,在反事实时间对上进行训练,这些时间对单在运动上有所不同,这样登记册就可以将视频的动态分解成紧凑的原生潜伏动作. 我们进一步提出了视觉语言行动(VLA)政策预训范式,即"世界模式(PAWlicy)预训行动"(Pretraining Actions from World Models (PAWlicy)),其中原住民LAM担任大型视频的动态教师;与世界行动模式不同,它从未产生视频. 原生潜伏动作在动作分类和控制回归方面都超过了LARY基准上的现有LAMS,并在新场景中,从人手到机器人,在新场景中重现同样的动作,虽然训练中并没有使用转移目标. 有了3.8B模式,PAWlicy在RoboTwin 2.0上的平均成功率达到93.6%,受过域域随机演示训练,在VLA中最高. 在RoboDojo,它在我们评价的每个维度上都是竞争的,我们评价的它的精度与领导牌的条目相当。 在真正的机器人上,它比两个任务上的pi_0.5基线都有改进. 两个阶段都只使用公共数据和公开发布的世界模型.

articles.title: Speak When You See It: Proactive Task Assistants Should Wait for Evidence, Not the Clock
articles.content: Proactive assistants that guide people through physical tasks must decide, every few seconds, whether a step is complete and whether a mistake has occurred. We find that two benchmarks for this task largely reward knowing when rather than seeing what: a timer that never looks at the video, raising an alarm at 25 s and confirming each step at 30 s, reaches a mistake F1 of 0.373 on Ego-MC-Bench, above every published result (at most 0.27). We formalize this as the video-blind frontier, the best trade-off between completion accuracy and mistake F1 that policies reach from the elapsed time, the instruction and training statistics alone: every published per-step result on Ego-MC-Bench lies inside it, and so do all twelve zero-shot models we run on QICD. To move beyond it, we introduce Evidence-Contrastive Training (ECT): fine-tune on the benchmark's own questions, and pair its positives with negatives from the same recording at the same elapsed time, so that elapsed time cannot separate the two sides of a pair. Trained on 209 QICD videos in about 15 GPU-hours, a 2B model with ECT crosses the frontier on both benchmarks in all four seeds; transferred to Ego-MC-Bench without adaptation, it confirms 59% of mistake-free steps in time, against 30% for a published model with the same backbone trained on about 25k synthetic counterfactuals and real recordings. Its decisions follow the video beyond what timing explains: at equal elapsed time it tells a finished step from an unfinished one in 90-92% of test pairs, where the instruction's typical duration reaches 65%, rescaling the time stamps between the frames leaves it essentially unchanged, and swapping in another recording, of the same recipe where one exists, cuts its completion accuracy by two thirds. The code and model weights will be publicly released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当你看到它时说话:主动任务助理应该等待证据,而不是时钟
articles.content_zh: 引导人们完成物理任务的主动助手必须每隔几秒钟决定一个步骤是否完整,是否发生了错误. 我们发现,这一任务的两个基准基本上有利于了解而不是看到什么:一个从不看视频的计时器,在25秒时发出警报,并在30秒时确认每个步骤,在Ego-MC-Bench上的F1误差为0.373,高于每个公布的结果(最多0.27)。 我们把它正式确定为视网膜边疆, 完成精度与错误之间的最佳权衡, 政策从过去的时间, 指令和培训统计本身: Ego-MC-Bench 上每一次公布的结果 都存在于其中, 为了超越它,我们引入了证据-联系训练(ECT):在基准本身的问题上进行微调,并将其正值与同一记录的负值同时配对,这样过去的时间不能将一对的两面分开。 在大约15 GPU小时的209 QICD视频上接受训练,一个带有ECT的2B模型在全部4个种子的两个基准上跨过边界;在没有改编的情况下转移至Ego-MC-Bench,它及时确认了59%的无误步骤,而对于一个在大约25k合成反事实和真实录音方面受过训练的具有相同骨干能力的出版模型来说,30%是无效的. 校对:Soup 代码和模型重量将公开发布.

articles.title: A High-Resolution UAV Benchmark Dataset and Baseline Evaluation for Teak Crown Segmentation in Western Ghats Tropical Forests
articles.content: Accurate teak-tree segmentation from high-resolution drone imagery is critical for sustainable plantation management, yet lacks dedicated benchmarks. We introduce TeakTreeNet, a comprehensive dataset and evaluation protocol for binary teak-tree segmentation at native 2cm resolution. Four state-of-the-art architectures: U-Net, PSPNet, DeepLabV3, and SegFormer were rigorously benchmarked across scratch and ImageNet-pretrained settings with three-seed reproducibility. SegFormer establishes new SOTA performance with F1 0.938 +/- 0.002 (Teak), IoU 0.968 +/- 0.001 (Teak), and Accuracy 0.986 +/- 0.001, outperforming all pretrained CNNs. Domain-adaptive training suffices, as the scratch SegFormer outperforms ImageNet pretrained baselines, avoiding large-scale pretraining overhead. Comprehensive analysis reveals Transformer's superior boundary delineation for dense plantation scenarios. TeakTreeNet provides researchers with 6391 expertly annotated drone patches (224x224) and establishes reproducible evaluation protocols, enabling direct comparison of future methods. Our benchmark demonstrates SegFormer's optimal balance of accuracy, efficiency, and deployability for operational forestry monitoring of teak plantations for India's western tropical forests.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 高分辨率无人驾驶航空器 西部加特斯热带森林的Teak王室分裂基准数据集和基线评价
articles.content_zh: 高分辨率无人机图像中的准确的茶叶树分化对于可持续种植园管理至关重要,但缺乏专门的基准。 我们介绍TeakTreeNet,这是一个综合数据集和评价协议,用于在原生2cm分辨率下进行二进制茶树分割。 四个最先进的架构:U-Net、PSPNet、DeepLabV3和SegFormer在划痕和ImageNet预设的三种子可复制的设置之间进行了严格的基准。 SegFormer以F1 0.938 +/- 0.002 (Teak),IoU 0.968 +/- 0.001 (Teak),以及精确度 0.986 +/- 0.001 设定了新的SOTA性能,超过了所有预训CNN. 域适应性训练就足够了,因为抓痕SegFormer超越了ImageNet预加训练的基线,避免了大规模预加训练的间接费用. 全面分析揭示了变形人对密集种植场场景的优越边界划分. TeakTreeNet为研究人员提供了6391个专家注解的无人机补丁(224x224),并建立了可复制的评价协议,可以直接比较未来的方法. 我们的基准表明,SegFormer在准确性、效率和可部署性方面,对印度西部热带森林的茶叶种植园进行林业业务监测,取得了最佳平衡。

articles.title: Learning the Next Best Move with Visual Diffusion Models
articles.content:
In this paper, we show that visual diffusion models can learn to predict the next best move (NBM) in tasks requiring sequential reasoning and lookahead, without explicitly exploring future steps or exhaustive searching at inference. Previous work demonstrated that these models can generate complete solutions to geometric and reasoning problems. Here, we show that simple fine-tuning on visual state--NBM pairs enables a pretrained model to select actions whose value depends on consequences several steps ahead. Each move is predicted directly in image space from the current state, without an explicit symbolic representation or search procedure. Repeated NBM predictions then construct a solution one decision at a time.
  We demonstrate this capability on chess puzzles and tile-based pathfinding, and show that it extends to Connect Four, Go and billiards. In chess, the model predicts legal moves and finds the best move far more often than by recalling similar training positions, including piece sacrifices whose benefit emerges only through later tactical continuations. In pathfinding, it constructs shortest paths on uniform-cost maps and cost-optimal routes across terrain tiles with different traversal costs, choosing longer routes when they are cheaper overall. These costs are learned implicitly from examples, without numerical cost supervision. These results show that direct visual move prediction can support globally informed decisions and successful sequential problem solving.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用视觉传播模式学习下一个最佳动作
articles.content_zh:
在本文中,我们表明,视觉传播模型可以在需要顺序推理和前瞻的任务中学习预测下一个最佳动作(NBM),而不明确探索未来的步骤或详尽的推论搜索. 以前的工作表明,这些模型可以产生几何和推理问题的完整解决方案. 在这里,我们显示,对视觉状态-NBM配对进行简单的微调可以使一个预先训练的模型能够选择其价值取决于未来几个步骤的后果的动作. 每个动作都是从当前状态直接在图像空间中预测的,没有明确的符号表示或搜索程序. 重复NBM预测,然后一次构建一个解决方案决定.
我们在棋局谜题和基于瓷砖的路径探寻上演示了这种能力,并显示它延伸到连接四,去和台球. 在国际象棋中,该模型预测法律动作,发现最佳动作比回顾类似的训练姿势要频繁得多,包括片面牺牲,其好处只通过后来的战术续作出现. 在寻找路径时,它用统一的成本地图构建最短的路径,并采用成本最佳的路线跨越地形瓦片,具有不同的转弯成本,在整体成本更低时选择更长的路线. 这些费用是从实例中隐含地学到的,没有数字成本监督。 这些结果显示,直接的视觉动作预测可以支持全球知情的决定和成功的顺序问题解决.

articles.title: XFreq: Geometry-Aligned Cross-View Residual Learning for Sparse 3D Ultrasound Reconstruction
articles.content: Three-dimensional (3D) ultrasound provides valuable volumetric context for anatomical assessment, motivating reconstruction from widely available two-dimensional (2D) slices. Sparse slices leave much of the volume unobserved, even when their acquisition poses are known. Existing methods interpolate observed intensities or incorporate learned 2D image features into 3D reconstruction, but their complementary roles in predicting smooth structure and residual details remain less explored. We introduce XFreq, a geometry-aligned framework for sparse 3D ultrasound reconstruction. It uses known slice poses and finite footprints to query 2D image features at 3D locations, complementing splatted intensities and sampling geometry. A low-frequency decoder predicts a smooth 3D field from the splat representation, while a high-frequency decoder additionally incorporates the queried 2D features to predict residual details. A learned gating module regulates the residual contribution based on geometry and cross-slice feature variation. We evaluate XFreq on an in-house fetal brain dataset and the public CETUS cardiac dataset, using slices resampled from 3D ultrasound volumes and fivefold cross-validation. Among the compared methods, XFreq achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM in most settings across both datasets, reaching 26.82 dB PSNR on CETUS with 32 input slices. Ablation studies further show the contributions of local feature querying, geometric cues, and residual prediction, with gains generally increasing as more input slices are used. Our findings highlight the value of geometry-aligned cross-view feature integration for reconstructing 3D ultrasound volumes from sparse 2D slices.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: XFreq: 几何- 相交截面残余学习 Sparse 3D 超声波重建
articles.content_zh: 三维(3D)超声波为解剖学评估提供了宝贵的量学背景,激发了广泛可用的二维(2D)切片的重建. Sparse切片使大部分体积无法观察,即使其获取姿势已知. 现有方法内插观察到的强度或将学到的二维图像特征纳入三维重建,但它们在预测平滑结构和剩余细节方面的互补作用仍然较少探索. 我们介绍XFreq,一个几何结构框架,用于稀少的3D超声波重建. 它使用已知的切片姿势和有限的足迹来查询3D位置的2D图像特征,以补充镀层强度和采样几何. 低频解码器会从浮标表示中预测一个光滑的3D字段,而高频解码器会额外融入被询问的2D特性来预测剩余细节. 一个学习的格子模块根据几何学和交叉切片特征变异来调节剩余的贡献. 我们在内部胎儿脑数据集和公共CETUS心脏数据集上评价XFreq,使用从3D超声波卷和5倍交叉验证重印的切片. 在比较方法中,XFreq在两个数据集的大多数设置中实现了最高的PSNR和SSIM,在CETUS上达到了26.82 dB PSNR,输入片32个. 校准研究进一步显示局部特征查询、几何提示和剩余预测的贡献,随着使用更多的输入片段,收益一般会增加。 我们的研究结果突出了几何-对齐的交叉视图特征集成对于从稀疏的2D片重建3D超声波卷的价值.

articles.title: CableMoE: Harm-Regularized Mean-Residual Expert Fusion for Transmission-Corridor Segmentation
articles.content: Semantic mapping of transmission corridors benefits from heterogeneous LiDAR and image-guided predictors, but replacing a strong ensemble with a learned router can damage rare electrical assets. We introduce CableMoE, a post-hoc mixture of four frozen segmentation experts. Its deployable prediction is a calibrated residual around availability-aware probability averaging, while a harm penalty discourages extra loss on points that the mean already classifies correctly. A matched component study shows why each design choice is needed: an unconstrained learned mixture loses 1.032 mIoU points relative to probability mean, harm regularization restores 0.359 points at fixed capacity, and removing an unnecessary point-wise gate slightly improves accuracy and stability. With three zones for fitting, two disjoint zones for residual-strength selection, and router-untouched t5b5 for final reporting, CableMoE obtains 84.906% mIoU and 98.140 % overall accuracy. This is +10.000 points over SPT and +0.263 over probability mean; all three seeds improve the latter. Across pylon, conductor, structural-cable, and insulator classes, macro-IoU rises from 84.517% for SPT and 97.153% for probability mean to 98.144 %. The results support conservative residual composition, not a claim of a new segmentation backbone or universal state of the art
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 电缆MoE: 损害规范化 传输-校正分区平均响应专家组合
articles.content_zh: 对传输走廊进行语义制图,得益于各种LiDAR和图像制导的预测器,但用学习的路由器取代一个强大的组合可能会损害稀有的电气资产。 我们介绍CableMoE, 后热混合 四个冷冻分解专家。 其可部署预测是围绕可获取性-可知概率平均值进行校准的剩余值,而伤害处罚则避免因平均值已经正确分类而造成额外损失。 一个匹配的组件研究显示为什么需要每个设计选择:一个不受约束的学习混合物相对于概率平均值损失了1.032 mIoU点,伤害规范化恢复了固定容量的0.359点,以及移除一个不必要的点位门略微提高了精度和稳定性. CableMoE有3个装配区、2个余力选择区和路由器未触碰的t5b5装配区,获得84.906%的MIOU和98.140%的总准确度。 这比小组委员会多出1万分,比概率平均值多出0.263分;这三种种子都改善了后者。 在整个管线、导线、结构可控和绝缘类中,大型IoU从小组委员会的84.517%和概率的97.53%上升到98.144%。 结果支持保守的残余成分,而不是声称有新的分化骨干或普遍技术水平

articles.title: Age and Gender Estimation from Face and Ocular Smartphone Images via Identity Transfer and Ordinal Learning
articles.content: We investigate the transferability of identity-recognition representations to gender and age estimation from face and ocular images. Three CNNs of varying complexity, pre-trained for face or ocular identity recognition, are evaluated using fixed features with SVMs and end-to-end adaptation. Experiments use 11,299 frontal smartphone images from Adience, following its predefined five-fold protocol and subject-disjoint validation. Results show that domain-matched identity pre-training outperforms direct ImageNet and scratch initialisation in end-to-end training, while combining both ocular regions narrows the gap with full-face estimation, especially for age. We additionally introduce an ordinal loss that exploits the ordering of age groups and consistently improves 1-off accuracy across architectures and input regions. Across the evaluated configurations, best gender accuracies reach 88.1% for the face and 82.9% for combined ocular regions, while age estimation reaches 59.0% exact and 93.1% 1-off accuracy for ocular images, versus 57.6% and 95.2% for the full face. To our knowledge, these are the highest ocular age accuracies reported on Adience.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过身份转让和普通学习从面部和视力智能手机图像中得出的年龄和性别估计
articles.content_zh: 我们调查身份识别表述从面部和视觉图像向性别和年龄估计的可转移性。 三种复杂程度不一的CNN,为面部或视觉身份识别预先训练,使用带有SVM的固定特性和端到端的适应性来评价. 实验使用来自Adience的11,299个前置智能手机图像,遵循其预先定义的五倍协议和主题偏差验证. 结果表明,与域匹配的身份前期培训超越了直接的ImageNet,并在端到端培训中抓取初始化,同时将两个视网膜区域结合起来,缩小差距与全面估计,特别是年龄估计。 此外,我们还引入了利用各年龄组的秩序的常规损失,并不断提高各架构和输入区域的1-1精确度。 在整个评估的配置中,面部最佳性别加速率达到88.1%,综合视力地区达到82.9%,而年龄估计则达到59.0%,视力图像为93.1%,而全面为57.6%,95.2%。 据我们所知,这是关于Adience报告的最高视力年龄。

articles.title: DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers
articles.content: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) scale model capacity by increasing both parameter count and computation. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants expand parameter capacity while keeping per-token computation roughly fixed, but still require substantial parameter storage. In this paper, we propose Dynamic Looped MoE DiT (DyLoMo-DiT), which reuses parameters rather than adding them: a weight-shared loop repeatedly applies the middle layers, while sparse experts allocate parameter capacity across tokens. This design deepens the network without adding parameters, freeing the parameter budget for other uses, such as more experts or more distinct layers. It also allocates compute dynamically, varying the number of passes across noise levels. Experiments show that DyLoMo-DiT makes more effective use of parameter and compute budgets, with further gains from assigning more passes to low-noise steps. On ImageNet $256\times256$, DyLoMo-DiT reduces FID by 11-24% relative to DiT and 36-56% relative to DiT-MoE at matched parameter and compute budgets. For text-to-image generation, a scaled DyLoMo-DiT achieves a higher GenEval score than FLUX.1 (0.714 vs. 0.673), with less than one tenth of its active parameters (1.05B vs. 12B).

articles.title_zh: DyLoMo- DIT: 动态循环混合操作器
articles.content_zh: 通过增加参数计数和计算,传播变压器(DiTs)比例模型容量. Mixture-of-Experts(MoE)变体扩展参数容量,同时保持每个托肯计算大致固定,但仍需要大量参数存储. 在本文中,我们提出动态循环 MoE DIT(DyLoMo-DIT),它可以重新使用参数而不是添加参数:一个权重共享的循环反复应用中间层,而稀疏的专家则将参数容量分配到符号之间. 这种设计在不添加参数的情况下加深了网络,将参数预算腾出来用于其他用途,如更多的专家或更独特的层. 它还以动态方式分配计算,不同噪音水平的通过次数。 实验表明,DyLoMo-DIT更有效地利用参数和计算预算,从给低噪音步骤分配更多的通行证中获得更多收益。 在ImageNet256\times256$上,DyLoMo-DIT在匹配参数和计算预算时将FID比DiT减少11-24%,比DiT-MoE减少36-56%. 对于文本到图像生成,一个缩放的DyLoMo-DIT实现了比FLUX.1(0.714 vs. 0.673)更高的GenEval分数,其活性参数不到十分之一(1.05B vs. 12B).

articles.title: Certified Defense against Adversarial Patches on Traffic Signs via Mask-Aware Training
articles.content: Adversarial patches are a practical threat to traffic-sign recognition: a small sticker on a sign can change a classifier's decision. PatchCleanser is a certified defense that applies two rounds of masking and, for every image it certifies, provably returns the correct label for any patch that fits inside one mask. We show that on traffic signs the defense certifies almost nothing when paired with a normally trained classifier (1.7% to 4.8% certified accuracy on GTSRB), because a single mask can hide the small central symbol that distinguishes sign classes. We propose mask-aware training, which trains the classifier on images occluded by random pairs drawn from the defense's own mask set, with a sampling bias toward masks over the sign's centre. The defense, mask set and certification procedure are unchanged, so the guarantee is preserved. For an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50, mask-aware training raises certified accuracy from 4.8% to 60.0%. Under real per-image adversarial patches, the defended ResNet-50 reaches 85.7% accuracy, versus 74.6% for the original PatchCleanser with a normally trained ResNet-50.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过蒙面-智能培训对交通标志上的异常补丁进行认证防御
articles.content_zh: 逆向补丁是对交通标志识别的实际威胁:在标志上贴上小贴可以改变分类者的决定. PatchCleanser是一种经过认证的防御,它应用两轮遮罩,并且,对于它所验证的每个图像,可以证明返回任何符合一个遮罩内的补丁的正确标签. 我们显示,在交通标志上,如果配对一个通常经过训练的分类器(GTSRB上为1.7%至4.8%的认证精度),则辩护方几乎不会认证任何内容,因为一个单一的面具可以隐藏区别标志类的小中央符号. 我们提议进行口罩意识训练, 训练分类员使用从防守者自己的口罩组中抽取的随机对联的图像, 对口罩进行取样偏重于标志中心。 辩护,面具套装和认证程序不变,因此保修保留. 对于一个ImageNet-pressed ResNet-50,口罩意识训练将认证的精度从4.8%提高到60.0%. 在真实的逐象对抗补丁下,防守的ResNet-50达到85.7%的准确度,而原装有通常训练有素的ResNet-50的PatchCleanser则达到74.6%.

articles.title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
articles.content: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ToolSmith:多式联运搜索代理工具自动生成框架
articles.content_zh: 最近多模式搜索代理使用推理、视觉和网络现场搜索等多种方式,通过组织一个手动搜索和视觉工具的小型图书馆来回答超出参数化知识的问题。 然而,当在野外遇到新的查询类型,证据格式,以及故障模式时,图书馆很难创建和维护,并被冻结. 相比之下,人类从业者则通过从熟悉的部分形成新的工具并跨任务再利用这些工具来解决工具不足的问题。 受此启发,我们提出 ToolSmith,一个自动工具生成框架,在精益基工具库上生长和再利用模块. 我们评价了根据VLM-as-a-Judge协议的三项域内多式联运搜索基准和十项域外基准。 ToolSmith在各种规模的部署人员中不断改进基础库,更大的骨干力量收获了更大的收益,显示了这一方法的可扩展性。 我们的代码和数据见https://teesr.github.io/toolsmith/。

articles.title: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
articles.content: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of four functional roles: intermediate reasoning, search-or-answer decision, search query generation, and final answer extraction. Evaluating all 2^4=16 role assignments without modifying weights or retraining defines a cooperative game whose Shapley values decompose the total RL gain across roles, while M"obius interaction terms distinguish standalone role improvements from multi-role coupling. Applying CO-GRAFT to Search-R1 agents across Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.2 models (spanning two sizes, base and instruction-tuned initializations, GRPO and PPO optimizers, and NQ and HotpotQA datasets), we show that query generation never exceeds 15% of the total gain; instead, gains are governed by pre-RL answer validity, search retention, model scale, and fixed task-level search budgets, shifting credit from reasoning toward answer extraction in larger or well-formatted answer response checkpoints while smaller base models rely on reasoning--decision coupling.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CO-GRAFT:通过角色级政策强化搜索人员的学习成果
articles.content_zh: 强化学习(RL)改进了大型语言模型搜索代理,在RL初始化前最多可达到32个精确匹配(EM)点,然而总体准确度的提高并不能识别哪些基础功能能力在培训期间改善或互动. 我们采用了CO-GRAFT,这是一个奖励-不可知的干预归属框架,在该框架中,一个经过RL训练的代理人及其RL前初始化联合产生一个在闭路式执行下进行现场检索的单一轨迹. 每个政策都控制着由四个功能角色组成的相互排斥的子集:中间推理,搜索-答案决定,搜索查询生成,以及最终答案提取. 评估所有2^4=16角色任务而不修改权重或再培训,定义了一种合作游戏,其Shapley值分解了角色间总的RL增益,而M"obius交互术语区分了独立的角色改进与多作用组合. 将CO-GRAFT应用于跨越Quen2.5和Llama-3.2模型的搜索-R1代理(扩展两个大小,基数和指令调试初始化,GPRO和PPO优化器,以及NQ和HotpotQA数据集),我们显示查询生成从未超过总收益的15%;相反,收益由RL前答题有效性,搜索保留,模型规模,以及固定的任务级搜索预算来管理,将信用从推理转移到在更大或格式完善的答题检查站的解答提取,而较小的基础模型依赖于推理-决定.

articles.title: Precision-Aware Learning Rate Transfer Across Block Count in LLM Post-Training
articles.content: The post-training of pretrained large language models, including supervised finetuning (SFT), direct preference optimization (DPO), and reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR), is very sensitive to the learning rate, and tuning it through grid search is costly in both computation and memory. In this work, we propose \textbf{TipSweep}, a method to transfer the learning rate across the number of trainable transformer blocks. To do so efficiently, we search for the best learning rate by training only the last $k_0$ blocks (in our experiments, typically $k_0=1$), and provide scaling rules that predict the optimal learning rate when training any set of $k$ blocks, including when $k=L$ (the full transformer). Across experiments with models ranging from 1 to 7 billion parameters, we observe that the optimal learning rate follows precision-dependent scaling rules: the optimal rate scales approximately as $k^{-1}$ with float32 (FP32) master weights, but as $k^{-1/2}$ when updates are applied directly to bfloat16 (BF16) weights without a master copy. We explain both rules using an analytical model that accounts for update rounding, under assumptions supported by profiling experiments. Finally, we develop two prototypes of the learning rate search for a 6.7-billion-parameter model. The first fits the search on a single consumer GPU with 16 GiB of memory. The second speeds up the search on a high-end GPU by evaluating all candidate learning rates in a single pass over the data, so that a five-candidate search takes about half the GPU hours of one full-depth ($k=L$) run.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在 LLM 培训后进行精密- 智能学习率跨块计数
articles.content_zh: 预先训练的大型语言模型的训练后,包括有监督的微调(SFT),直接的偏好优化(DPO),以及可核查的奖励的强化学习(RLVR),对学习速率非常敏感,通过网格搜索进行调试在计算和内存上都是昂贵的. 在这项工作中,我们提出\textbf{TipSweep},一种将学习速率跨越可训练变压器块数的方法. 为了高效完成这项工作,我们只通过培训最后的$k_0美元块(在我们实验中,一般为$k_0=1美元)来寻找最佳学习率,并提供缩放规则,在培训任何一组$k$块时预测最佳学习率,包括当$k=L$(全变压器)时. 通过从10亿到70亿参数的模型实验,我们观察到,最佳学习率遵循了精度依赖的缩放规则:最佳学习率的尺度大约为$k^{-1}$,其中浮点32(FP32)主重,但当更新直接应用到bfloat16(BF16)重而无主重复制时,则相当于$k^{-1/2}$. 我们使用一个分析模型来解释这两项规则,该模型将考虑到更新四舍五入的情况,其假设得到剖析实验的支持。 最后,我们开发了两个原型 学习率搜索 一个67亿参数模型。 第一个适合在单一消费GPU上的搜索,包含16GiB的内存. 第二段通过一次通过数据传递来评价所有考生的学习率来加快对高端GPU的搜索,这样一个5个候选人的搜索大约需要1个全深度(k=L$)运行的GPU半小时.

articles.title: Deneb-Vritra: Descriptions, Edges and Names Examined by Blocking Via Restoring Token Representations and Attention
articles.content: Laya is a 421M-parameter encoder that answers a question about a text in one pass: each answer option, written as a name plus a description, gets a marker token, and one score is read from the network at each marker. We first confirm that such models can follow an option's name when it contradicts the description; the question is where in the network this happens. We locate it. On 951 synthetic questions we move each name onto another option's description and count how often the model picks the option with the right name (the name shortcut): 53% for the released checkpoint, 59% for our fine-tune v1, 11% for a fine-tune with name randomisation. On a 320-item sample, blocking attention from each marker to its own name tokens in layers 14 to 17 of 28 cuts v1's shortcut from 67% to 16% (19% on two schemas held out from component selection) while accuracy with the original names stays at 90%; blocking marker edges to the question, other options or text has no effect. No single head matters (largest effect 9 points), and restoring clean marker states undoes the swap from layer 16. Attention mass tracks the window by layer but not by head. Repeated on 5 checkpoints (released, fine-tuned, name-randomised, and a pair trained without two schemas), the knockout finds similar layers; in the name-randomised ones, blocking the description edges instead brings the shortcut back to 56-58%, so the read persists and is outvoted. Marker states decode the name from layer 0; a one-direction probe erasure changed nothing but was weaker than a random edit. Copying layers 0-13 or 14-27 of a name-randomised sibling into a fine-tune recovers 66% and 65% (v1); 21% and 45% (pair A) of its shortcut reduction. 9 of the 12 predictions we could score, written before running, failed. Head sweeps cover 5 of 5 checkpoints; data are synthetic and LLM-labelled; one architecture.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Deneb-Vritra:通过封锁Via恢复Token代表并引起注意而审查的描述、边缘和名称
articles.content_zh: Laya是一个421M-参数编码器,它在一个通道中回答一个有关文本的问题:每个答案选项,写成一个名字加一个描述,得到一个标记符号,每个标记从网络读取一个分数. 我们首先确认,当这种模型与描述相矛盾时,它可以跟随一个选项的名称;问题是网络中发生这种情况的地方. 我们找到它。 在951个合成问题上,我们把每个名字移到另一个选项的描述上,并算出模型每隔多久会选择正确名称的选项(名称快捷键):53%用于已放出的检查站,59%用于我们的微调v1,11%用于名称随机化的微调. 在一个320项样本中,在28个剪切v1的快捷键的第14至17层(从67%到16%的快捷键)(在选择部件时的两个方案上占19%)中阻断每个标记对自身名称符号的注意,而原名的准确度则保持在90%;阻断问题的标记边缘,其他选项或文本没有效果. 没有单一头事项(最大效果9分),恢复干净的标记状态可以取消第16层的互换. 注意质量逐层追踪窗口,但不是按头跟踪. 在5个检查站(放行,精细调整,命名随机,以及一对训练无两招的选手)上反复出现,淘汰赛发现的层次相似;在命名随机的检查站中,阻断描述边缘反而使快捷键回落到56%至58%,因此读数持续,被淘汰. Marker表示名称从第0层解码;一个单向探测器的擦除没有改变任何东西,只是比随机编辑弱. 将名称随机化的兄弟姐妹的0-13或14-27层复制到微调中,可回收66%和65%(v1);其捷径减少的21%和45%(A段)。 12个预言中的9个在跑步前写成,失败了. 头部扫荡覆盖5个检查站中的5个;数据是合成的和LLM标签的;一个架构.

articles.title: Serialization and the Character-System: Measuring Narrative Concentration in French Fiction (1800--1940)
articles.content: Every novel divides a finite quantity of narrative attention among its characters, and whether the shape of that division, between a narrative organized around a single figure and one spread across a crowd, has a history is far less settled than the abundance of critical commentary on protagonists might suggest. We operationalize Woloch's notion of the character-system, the distribution of narrative attention across a novel's cast structured by the tension between "the one" and "the many", as the inequality (Gini coefficient) of the PageRank distribution over a character network. We trace this measure of structural concentration across 12,011 French novels published between 1800 and 1940, drawn from the Hors d'usage corpus of Gallica fiction. Over the long nineteenth century the trajectory is U-shaped, with concentration declining to a trough in the 1850s-1860s and rising again through the turn of the century. The change is small, comparable to the difference between a novel built on two co-equal protagonists and one built on a single protagonist, but it is robust to the character cutoff, corpus density, cast size, and author effects. Detective and adventure fiction are less concentrated than the average novel of their period. Literary history reads the roman-feuilleton either as the novel of a superior hero or as a form of proliferating episodes, and on this structural measure our results support the second reading. Across the age of the feuilleton (1840-1914), authors whose careers were structured by newspaper serialization distribute centrality more evenly than a literary control, net of period, genre, and canon. Because such claims are only as trustworthy as the networks they rest on, we also evaluate the extraction pipeline against manually annotated novels, at the levels of cast and character identity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 序列化与字符体系:测量法国小说中的叙述浓度(1800年-1940年)
articles.content_zh: 每部小说都在其人物中划分了数量有限的叙事关注,而这种划分的形状,在一个围绕一个数字组织起来的叙事和一个分布在人群中的叙事之间,其历史是否远不如众多批评主角的评论所暗示的那么稳定. 我们把沃洛奇对人物体系的概念, 故事关注的分布, 在一个小说中, 我们在1800年到1940年间出版的12,011部法国小说中追踪了这种结构集中的度量,这些小说取材自加尔利卡小说中的Hors d'usage accoup. 在19世纪的长时期内,轨迹呈U形,1850年代-1860年代集中度下降到槽状,并在世纪之交再次上升。 变化是小的,可以与以两个共同的主角和一个共同的主角为主的小说之间的区别相比,但对于角色的切除,命案密度,铸造大小,以及作者的效果来说,变化很强. 侦探和冒险小说与其时期的一般小说相比不太集中. 文学史将罗马-费伊莱顿读作"上等英雄的小说"或"扩散剧集的形式",在这个结构度量上,我们的成果支持二读. 在整个费伊莱顿时代(1840-1914年),其事业通过报纸连载编排的作者分配的中心位置比文学控制更为均匀,无期,流派,和犬类. 由于这种主张只是像他们所依赖的网络一样值得信赖,我们还根据人工注释的小说,在铸造和品格认同层面,对提取管道进行评估。

articles.title: Attention Temperature Confounds Zero-Shot Context Extension
articles.content: A training-time attention change is usually judged for zero-shot context extension against a dense baseline beyond the training length at the default temperature, $τ= 1$. The outcome depends on how miscalibrated the baseline is there: the share of perplexity it recovers when its logits are sharpened by one scalar. Under the standard recipe (fp32 master weights), an 8k-trained baseline is 8-15% miscalibrated at 30k in three seed-paired 365M twins; in one of them this makes the block-sparse-trained twin look 7% better, which calibration removes. In pure-bf16 training without master weights the miscalibration is several times larger: an AdamW step ($β_2 = 0.95$) on a gain initialised at 1.0 is below half the bf16 spacing at peak learning rates under $1.7\times10^{-3}$, so gains never move (22 checkpoints), the baseline is 37-58% miscalibrated, and block-sparse pretraining, attention dropout and ALiBi look 6-35% better. Calibrating one temperature per model and length removes all three advantages, leaves ALiBi 5% behind RoPE and keeps part of the gain of a positive control, NTK-aware scaling. Unfreezing the gains reverses the block-sparse advantage at 365M and removes 71-89% of it at 1.2B. We recommend reporting extension results at calibrated temperatures and checking that normalisation gains moved.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 注意温度 解析 0- Shot 背景扩展
articles.content_zh: 通常根据在默认温度下超过训练长度的密集基线,即1美元,判断培训时间的注意力变化。 其结果取决于基线的校准有多么错误:当它的对数被一个标尺磨净时,它恢复的复杂度的比例。 在标准配方(fp32主重)下,8k训练的基准量为8-15%,在3个种子派生365M双胞胎的30k时误判;在其中1个中,这使得块-sparse训练双胞胎看起来更好7%,校准可以去除. 在纯bf16没有主重的训练中,校准误差是数倍:在1.0分的增益上,AdamW步(+β_2 = 0.95美元)低于1.7\times10^{-3}美元最高学习率的bf16间隔的一半,因此增益从不移动(22个检查站),基线误差37-58%,挡板预训、注意力中断和ALiBi看起来好6-35%。 校准每个模型一个温度和长度可以消除所有三个优点,让ALIBI 5%落后于ROPE,并保留了正控,NTK-意识缩放的部分收益. 解冻收益逆转了365M的块状散射优势,并在1.2B上移除了其中的71-89%. 我们建议在经过校准的温度下报告扩展结果,并检查正常化收益是否移动。

articles.title: Look Back, Draft Ahead: Corrective Prefix Attention for Parallel Speculative Decoding
articles.content: Parallel speculative decoders propose an entire token block at once, yet one early inconsistency can cause the target to reject its remaining suffix. We introduce Corrective Prefix Attention (CPA), which combines prefix-aware selection with autoregressive supervision to improve these parallel drafts. CPA lets each candidate attend to earlier choices within the block. Fixed candidate shortlists allow all pairwise interactions to be computed before selection, reducing the sequential walk to table lookups, accumulation and lightweight scoring rather than repeated neural evaluations. An auxiliary autoregressive loss trains the shared backbone on clean prefixes without adding an inference pass. Across eight math, code and dialogue benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B targets on Ascend NPUs, CPA commits 13--15\% more tokens per verification round than DSpark and 25--26\% more than DFlash. Its mean speedups reach $3.35\times$ and $3.37\times$ under greedy decoding and $2.86\times$ under sampling for both targets. Ablations support both components, while capacity sweeps demonstrate that greater acceptance alone does not guarantee faster decoding. These results motivate correcting parallel proposals with causal information while keeping sequential computation inexpensive.

articles.title_zh: 回首看, 草稿标题: 纠正前缀注意并行切换
articles.content_zh: 平行的投机解码器同时提出一个完整的符号块,然而一个早期的不一致会导致目标拒绝其剩余的后缀. 我们引入了修正前缀注意(CPA),将前缀感知选择和自递式监督结合起来,改进这些平行的草稿. 《全面和平协定》允许每位候选人在街区内参加较早的选择。 固定候选人短名单允许在甄选前计算所有对偶互动,从而减少按顺序走进桌边看、积累和轻量级评分,而不是重复的神经评价。 辅助自动递减器在清洁前缀上对共享主干线进行列车,但不增加推论通行证. Ascend NPU上的Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B目标在8个数学、代码和对话基准中, CPA承诺每轮核查比DSpark多13-15++++x, 它的平均速度在贪婪的解码下达到3.35\time$和3.37\time$,在两个目标的取样下达到2.86\time$. 缩写支持两个组件,而容量扫描显示,单凭接受程度提高并不能保证更快的解码. 这些结果促使用因果信息纠正平行建议,同时使顺序计算费用低廉。

articles.title: Unlocking the Power of Loops in Pretrained LLMs with Loop Residuals
articles.content: Looped Transformers iterate a shared block of layers to increase computation without adding parameters, offering stronger performance and test-time scaling. However, this power has so far required training from scratch and yielded only modest gains for LLMs. Finetuning existing models into loops is far cheaper, yet also brings only marginal gains over SFT. We propose LoopRes, an effective, scalable, and simple approach that turns loops into significant and consistent gains for pretrained LLMs. Building on Attention Residuals, LoopRes lets each looped layer attend directly to the outputs of earlier loops. Since these outputs are iterates of the same layers and become harder to tell apart, we give each a trainable loop-aware key that encodes its structural identity. Attending to all earlier loops also lets layers skip intermediate ones, so we restrict each layer to a residual window of the latest W loops, forcing every loop to build incrementally on recent ones. Across 6 pretrained LLMs from 3 model families and 9 benchmarks, LoopRes delivers significant and consistent gains: at 2x compute, it improves Qwen3-1.7B-Base by 29.1% over SFT, more than doubling the gain of the state-of-the-art baseline. The gains hold on larger models up to 30B and across all three families. More importantly, from 1.7B to 8B, LoopRes scales more steeply than SFT as compute grows, reaching a higher ceiling while needing less compute on long outputs. These results establish LoopRes as an effective looping approach, delivering both better performance and better test-time scaling.

articles.title_zh: 解锁预装LLMs中的环流电源和环流残渣
articles.content_zh: 循环变形器在不增加参数的情况下,将一个共享的层块进行结构化,以增加计算,提供更强的性能和测试时间缩放. 然而,迄今为止,这种权力需要从零开始的培训,对有限责任公司只取得了有限的收益。 将现有模型精细化为环路成本要低得多,但也只比SFT带来边际收益. 我们提议LoopRes, 一种有效、可扩展和简单的方法, 在注意残余的基础上,LoopRes让每个循环层直接关注早期循环的输出. 由于这些输出是同一层的迭代,并且变得难以分辨,所以我们给每个都一个可调节其结构特性的可导环感键. 注意早期的所有循环,也让层层跳过中间的循环,所以我们把每层限制在最新的W循环的剩余窗口上,迫使每个循环在最近的一个循环上逐步建立起来. 在3个模范家庭和9个基准的6个经过预先培训的LLMs中,LoopRes提供了显著和一致的收益:在2x计算时,它比SFT改进了Qune3-1.7B-Base的29.1%,比最先进的基线增加了一倍以上。 收益维持在30B以下的较大模式上,并覆盖所有三个家庭。 更重要的是,从1.7B到8B,随着SFT的计算增长,循环空间尺度比SFT更陡峭,达到较高的上限,同时对长产出的计算需要较少。 这些结果将LoopRes确定为一种有效的循环方法,既能提供更好的性能,又能提供更好的测试时间规模。

articles.title: UMAMI: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset for Evidence-Grounded Dietary Decisions
articles.content: Dietary decisions require identifying a food's nutrient content and considering individual dietary needs, but recognizing food from an image alone does not provide this information. Visually similar foods can have different nutrient profiles, so selecting the wrong food record can lead to incorrect decisions even when nutrient rules are applied correctly. Furthermore, satisfying nutrient constraints does not necessarily establish a food's relevance to a person's intake. Evaluating these challenges together requires connecting food images, nutrient records, and individual intake histories. To support this evaluation, we introduce UMAMI (Unified Multimodal Assessment of Meals and Intake), a multimodal dataset and benchmark linking independently collected food images with nutrient profiles and respondent health and intake records. Using this dataset, we construct three diagnostic tasks covering visual nutrient question answering, personalized food recommendation, and condition-aware food substitution. Paired instances and input controls examine how visual identity and respondent context affect decisions. Our experiments identify errors in both food-record selection and nutrient-rule application, while showing that higher rule compliance does not necessarily improve alignment with subsequent recorded intake. These findings highlight the need to evaluate how multimodal systems select and use structured evidence for dietary decisions. The dataset, code, and dashboard are available at https://umami-benchmark.github.io.

articles.title_zh: UMAMI: 证据组合饮食决定的多式联运基准数据集
articles.content_zh: 饮食决定要求确定食物的营养含量和考虑个人的饮食需求,但仅从形象上确认食物并不能提供这种信息。 视觉上相似的食物可以有不同的营养素特征,因此选择错误的食物记录会导致错误的决定,即使营养素规则得到正确应用. 此外,满足营养限制并不一定确定食物与个人摄入量的相关性。 要共同评估这些挑战,就必须将食物图像、营养记录和个人摄入历史联系起来。 为支持这一评估,我们采用了UMAMI(膳食和摄入量统一多式联运评估),这是一个将独立收集的食品图像与营养素剖面和应答健康和摄入量记录联系起来的多式联运数据集和基准。 利用这个数据集,我们构建了三个诊断任务,包括视觉营养素问题回答,个性化食品推荐,以及状况感知食品替代. Paired实例和输入控制审查视觉身份和被申请人的背景如何影响决定。 我们的实验发现在食品记录选择和营养规则应用中都存在错误,同时表明遵守更高的规则并不一定能改善与随后记录的摄入量的一致性. 这些调查结果突出表明,需要评价多模式系统如何选择和使用结构化证据进行饮食决策。 数据集、代码和仪表板见https://umami-benchmark.github.io。

articles.title: DKnown-Jev-2: Article-Level Answer-Evidence Classification and Efficient Inference with a Pre-trained Language Model
articles.content: Evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering requires determining whether a candidate article contains content that directly supports an answer under the applicable conditions of the question. We present DKnown-Jev-2, an article-level answer evidence classifier designed for evidence integration across multiple paragraphs. The model jointly encodes question conditions, article metadata, and paragraph content, and uses a pointer-style classification head to predict Answer Evidence (AE) and Non-answer Evidence (NE) in a single forward pass. Ona manually annotated test set of 972 evaluation instances, DKnown-Jev-2 achieves 91.77% accuracy and 91.28% macro-F1, outperforming Jev by 2.16 and 2.37 percentage points, respectively, while reducing both evidence misses and non-evidence false positives. The test set contains 317 multi-paragraph instances, with a maximum body length of 9,322 characters. Shared article encoding and non-autoregressive classification support low-latency inference. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method for article-level evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering.

articles.title_zh: Dnown-Jev-2: 条款级的回答-证据分类和对预培训语言模型的有效推论
articles.content_zh: 在规范性知识问题回答中选择证据,需要确定候选文章是否包含在问题适用条件下直接支持答案的内容。 我们提出Dknown-Jev-2, 一个条款级的回答证据分类器,旨在将证据纳入多个段落。 该模型联合编码了问题条件,文章元数据和段落内容,并使用指针式的分类头来预测单向前传的回答证据(AE)和非回答证据(NE). Ona手动附加说明的测试集共972个评价实例,DKnown-Jev-2的精度为91.77%,宏观-F1的精度为91.28%,分别比Jev的精度高出2.16和2.37个百分点,同时减少了证据缺失和非证据的假阳性. 测试集包含317个多段实例,最大身长为9,322个字符. 共享物品编码和非自动递归分类支持低相关性推论. 这些结果表明,在规范性知识问题的回答中,拟议的条款一级证据选择方法是有效的。

articles.title: CAST: A Deployed Speech-to-Text Cascade for Closed Captioning of Entertainment Television
articles.content: Despite rapid progress in automatic speech recognition (ASR), caption generation for long-form entertainment video remains challenging for content dense in music and effects, rich in accents, crosstalk, and noise. The transcript quality depends on segmentation and surrounding modules as much as the acoustic model. A single pass voice activity detection (VAD) can miss faint, low-energy voice while forwarding near-silent segments that induce hallucination and repetition in an autoregressive decoder. These competing errors motivate a hierarchical VAD that revisits rejected segments under semantic and acoustic retention checks. We present Captioning ASR Stack for Television (CAST), an integrated speech-to-text pipeline for closed captioning (CC) combining frozen Whisper large-v3 with segmentation, language identification, lyrics routing, and targeted hallucination detection and repair on a single NVIDIA L4 GPU. On 100 in-house assets spanning 60.46 hours, CAST reduces normalized WER from 6.99% to 5.36% and subtitle edit rate from 254.2 to 221.9 min/hour against the WhisperX pipeline, and improves deletion rate by 11% on public datasets. We also present the behavior of each stage in the pipeline. CAST entered the production speech-to-text (STT) stage of our CC pipeline in late August 2026; we report the evaluation evidence and path to full-scale operation.

articles.title_zh: CAST: 娱乐电视闭合字幕应用语音对文字连锁
articles.content_zh: 尽管在自动语音识别(ASR)方面迅速取得进展,但长式娱乐视频的字幕生成对于音乐和效果密集、口音丰富、交叉交谈和噪音等内容仍然具有挑战性。 笔录质量与声学模型一样,都取决于分区和周边模块. 单一的通过语音活动检测(VAD)可以错过昏暗的,低能的语音,同时转发在自动减码器中诱发幻觉和重复的近沉寂的片段. 这些相互竞争的错误促使VAD在语义和声学保留检查下重新审视被拒绝的部分。 将冷冻的Whisper大V3与分区、语言识别、歌词路由、以及目标明确的幻觉探测和修复合并在单一的NVIDIA L4 GPU上。 在超过60.46小时的100个内部资产上,CAST将正常WER从6.99%降至5.36%,对WhisperX管道的字幕编辑率从254.2分降至221.9分/小时,并将公共数据集的删除率提高11%。 我们还介绍了管道中每个阶段的行为。 CAST于2026年8月下旬进入我国CC输油管的生产语音对文本(STT)阶段;我们报告评价证据和全面运行的道路.

articles.title: Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
articles.content: Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract. Pretrained vision encoders already capture this information in their latent features, with CLIP linking objects to image regions, DINOv3 matching semantics across views, and VGGT encoding multi-view geometry. However, VLMs do not benefit from these features when we present them directly in context as grayscale feature images. We therefore propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses latent features into explicit spatial evidence for VLMs. In LatentParse, an analyst VLM probes the features of all three encoders with predefined tools that locate objects, track them across views, and measure motion between views. It then distills the results into a concise text report, which is provided together with the images to the VLM to answer the question. We evaluate LatentParse on MMSI-Bench, MV-RoboBench and SPAR-Bench, where it improves all five VLMs over the photo-only baseline by 0.7-2.4 percentage points on average. On MMSI-Bench, it raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.4% to 39.5%, with the largest improvements of 19.2 percentage points on the camera-related questions. These results suggest that latent features become useful for spatial reasoning once they are parsed into relation evidence, without training. Code is available at https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse.

articles.title_zh: 分析多种方式空间理由的视觉工具
articles.content_zh: 跨越多种观点的空间推理需要从2D观测中推断出物体与相机之间的3D关系,这取决于交叉视图的对应和场景几何,视觉语言模型(VLMs)不能可靠地提取. 预先训练的视觉编码器已经在其潜伏的特性中捕捉到这种信息,CLIP将对象与图像区域联系起来,DINOv3匹配跨视图的语义,以及VGGT编码多视图几何. 然而,当我们直接把它们作为灰色尺度的特征图像呈现时,VLM并没有从这些特征中受益. 因此,我们提议LatentParse这一无培训框架,将潜在特征描述为VLM的明确空间证据。 在LatentParse中,一位分析师VLM用预先定义的工具探测所有三个编码器的特性,这些编码器可以定位物体,在视图之间跟踪它们,并在视图之间测量运动. 然后将结果提炼成一份简明的文本报告,报告连同图像一起提供给VLM,以回答问题. 我们在MMSI-Bench、MV-RoboBench和SPAR-Bench上评价LatentParse,它使所有五个VLM平均比光线基线提高0.7-2.4个百分点。 在MMSI-Bench上,它将Quen3.8-27B从34.4%提升到39.5%,相机相关问题的最大改进度达到19.2个百分点. 这些结果表明,潜在特征一旦被解析成关系证据,而不经过培训,就有利于空间推理。 代码见https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse.

articles.title: Can Latent Reasoning Drive LLM Outputs Without a Trace?
articles.content: LLMs typically solve complex tasks with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, which is also the main tool for monitoring them for misaligned behavior. However, standard transformers can also solve tasks with complete latent reasoning (CLR), carrying out the whole task internally and outputting only the final answer. Theory bounds the depth of CLR, the number of sequential steps it can carry out, and recent work measured it to be shallow. In this work, we ask whether CLR is deep enough for a model to pursue a hidden objective that requires reasoning. Such a model would generate a CoT that appears to solve the given task, while a latent multi-step computation decides its answer based on the hidden objective. First, we show that a simple auxiliary loss allows models to solve a multi-step task latently at least 5x deeper than previously reported. Then, in two common tasks, decision-making and code generation, we train a model to pursue such a hidden objective, which decides a loan or plants a vulnerability. The model's CoT justifies the output with no trace of the hidden objective, and a strong LLM monitor does not flag it. Finally, using activation patching, we find that the latent computation is completed before the model generates its CoT, which takes no part in it. Altogether, we show that a hidden objective that requires reasoning can go unseen by a monitor that reads only the output.

articles.title_zh: 原始理性驱动 LLM 输出没有追踪吗 ?
articles.content_zh: LLMs一般用思维链(CoT)推理解决复杂任务,这也是监测错配行为的主要工具. 然而,标准变压器也可以用完整的潜伏推理(CLR)来解决任务,在内部执行整个任务,只输出最后的答案. 理论将CLR的深度,它可以进行的顺序步骤的数量,以及最近的工作测得它很浅. 在这部作品中,我们问CLR是否足够深入,一个模型是否能够追求一个需要推理的隐藏目标. 这种模型将产生一个似乎能解决既定任务的CoT,而潜在的多步骤计算则根据隐藏的目标决定答案. 首先,我们表明,简单的辅助损失使模型能够至少比以往报告更深地潜在地解决多步骤任务。 然后,在两个共同的任务中,即决策和代码生成,我们训练一个模式来追求这样一个隐藏的目标,这个模式决定贷款或工厂是一种脆弱性. 该模型的CoT为输出提供了理由,没有隐藏目标的痕迹,一个强大的LLM显示器没有标注它. 最后,利用激活补丁,我们发现潜在计算是在模型生成其CoT之前完成的,它不参与其中. 总之,我们显示,一个需要推理的隐藏目标,可以通过只读输出的显示器来隐蔽.

articles.title: RoboUniverse-10K: Toward the Scaling Era of Agentic Robotics via Real-to-Sim Environments
articles.content: Agentic Robotics, in which foundation models act as coding agents to control robots through executable programs, has emerged as a compelling paradigm for embodied intelligence. Yet unlike software engineering, where massive executable environments power post-training, robotics remains constrained by small, manual benchmarks and in-distribution evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoboUniverse-10K, 10,807 interactive, resettable, and verifiable physics environments built from real-world videos via an automated Real2Sim and quality assurance pipeline. Each runs in an isolated, Harbor-compatible harness that hides privileged states and grading logic to mirror real-world sensing. From the same pipeline, we hold out 500 unseen tasks to establish RoboUniverse-Verified, an expert-verified zero-shot benchmark. Evaluating 11 closed- and open-source models reveals a huge gap: frontier models reach 85.8\% success, while open-source baselines lag at 2.6\% to 10.0\%, bottlenecked by low-level grasping, deformable-object manipulation, and post-contact physical control. Finally, we collect about 17K multi-turn trajectories totaling 0.79B tokens with GPT-6 Astra and perform full-parameter supervised fine-tuning on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, yielding RoboUniverse-35B-A3B. Our model achieves substantial zero-shot gains on RoboUniverse-Verified, lifting the success rate from 0.8\% to 21.2\%, while achieving zero-shot task completions across LIBERO-MAX, RoboCasa, RoboTwin 2.0, and a real Franka arm. We open-source the RL-ready environments and model to lay the foundation for large-scale reinforcement learning in Agentic Robotics.

articles.title_zh: RoboUniverse-10K:通过Real-to-Sim环境实现代理机器人时代的放大
articles.content_zh: 代理机器人(Agentic Robotics),其中基础模型起到编码代理作用,通过可执行程序控制机器人,它已成为体现智能的令人信服的范式. 然而,与软件工程不同的是,在软件工程中,大规模可执行环境在培训后提供动力,机器人仍然受到小型手工基准和分配评价的限制。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了RoboUniverse-10K,10,807交互,可重置,可核查的物理环境,这些环境是通过一个自动化的Real2Sim和质量保证管道从现实世界视频中构建的. 每个都运行在一个孤立的,与港湾兼容的拉带中,隐藏特权状态和分级逻辑来映射真实世界的感知. 在同一条管道中,我们承担着500项不可见的任务,以建立 " Robo Universe-Veriferated " ,一个经过专家验证的零射线基准。 评估11个封闭式和开源式模型揭示了一个巨大的差距:前沿模型达到85.8\%成功,而开源基线则滞后于2.6\%到10.0\%,被低水平的抓取,变形-对象操纵,以及接触后物理控制所瓶颈. 最后,我们收集了约17K个多转轨距,共含GPT-6 Astra的0.79B令牌,并在Qune3.6-35B-A3B上执行全参数监督微调,产生RoboUniverse-35B-A3B. 我们的模式在RoboUniverse-Veriferized上取得了实质性的零射得分,成功率从0.8×××提高到21.2××××××××,同时在LIBERO-MAX,RoboCasa,RoboTwin2.0上实现了零射任务完成,还有真正的Franka臂. 我们开放了RL准备环境和模式,为在Agentic Robotics进行大规模强化学习奠定基础.

articles.title: CART: Clustering-based Analysis of Recurring narratives for Taxonomy construction
articles.content: We present CART, a computational pipeline for extracting political narratives from parliamentary discourse and organizing them into a data-driven taxonomy without relying on predefined narrative categories. It encodes parliamentary discourse using semantic representations, filters relevant and reliable content through unsupervised confidence estimation, extracts narrative statements using LLMs, and uses narrative clustering and cluster analysis to construct a narrative taxonomy. Applied to Greek Parliament proceedings surrounding the 2023 Tempi train crash, it identifies ten recurring narrative families concerning responsibility attribution, institutional failure, railway safety, accountability, privatization, and the political interpretation of the tragedy. Our results demonstrate how combining unsupervised learning with LLM narrative extraction enables large parliamentary corpora to be transformed into interpretable, data-driven taxonomies of political narratives.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CART: 分类学建设经常叙述分析分组分析
articles.content_zh: 我们提出CART,这是从议会讨论中提取政治叙事的计算管道,将其组织成一个数据驱动的分类学,而不依赖预先界定的叙事类别。 它使用语义表述编码议会话语,通过不受监督的信心估计过滤相关和可靠的内容,使用LLMs提取叙事声明,使用叙事分组和分组分析来构建叙事分类学. 它适用于希腊议会关于2023年Tempi火车坠毁的诉讼程序,它确定了十个反复出现的叙述家庭,涉及责任归属、体制失败、铁路安全、问责制、私有化以及对悲剧的政治解释。 我们的结果显示,将不受监督的学习与LLM叙事提炼相结合,能够把大型议会公司转变为可解释、数据驱动的政治叙事分类。

articles.title: Beyond Self-Consistency: Recursive Self-Improvement at Test Time
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) that continue improving after deployment (e.g., recursive self-improvement) offer a promising path toward general intelligence. Current test-time methods pursue this goal on unlabeled questions, primarily relying on self-consistency: they generate independent solutions and use majority voting to select an answer or construct training targets. This leaves earlier reasoning unused at inference and can reinforce an incorrect majority during training. Humans instead build on earlier attempts to preserve useful reasoning, correct mistakes and improve their problem-solving strategies. Following this principle, we propose Test-Time Recursive Self-Improvement (TT-RSI), a label-free framework for improving LLMs at test time through two mutually reinforcing components: (1) In-Context RSI repeatedly re-solves each question using the full previous solution as a reference, letting the model decide whether and how to use it so that inference compute builds on earlier reasoning. (2) In-Weight RSI distills successive refinements into the model's weights, enabling progress beyond an initially wrong majority and theoretically bringing the first attempt toward the model's infinite-step refinement limit. The updated model answers better and refines more effectively, generating stronger references for subsequent training. Extensive experiments show that TT-RSI improves average accuracy by +13.89% over the base model and outperforms the strongest self-consistency-based method by +4.79% under the same test-time scaling budget.

articles.title_zh: 超越自我一致性:测试时的递归自我提升
articles.content_zh: 部署后继续改进的大型语言模型(如递归自我改进)为通向一般智能提供了一条很有希望的道路。 目前的测试时间方法在无标签的问题上追求这一目标,主要依靠自我一致性:它们产生独立的解决方案,并使用多数投票来选择答案或构建培训目标. 这使得先前的推理在推论上没有被利用,在培训期间可能会强化不正确的多数。 人类反而在先前的尝试基础上更上一层楼,以保持有用的推理,纠正错误并改进其解决问题的战略. 按照这一原则,我们提议试验时间递归自我改进(TT-RSI),这是在试验时间通过两个相辅相成的组成部分改进LLM的无标签框架: (1)Context RSI反复重解每个问题,使用之前的完全解决方案作为参考,让模型决定是否以及如何使用它,以便推论计算建立在早期推理的基础上. (2)In-Wight RSI将连续的精度提炼成模型的权重,使得进步超越最初错误的多数,理论上将第一次尝试引向模型无限步骤的精度极限. 更新后的模型答案更好,改进更有效,为以后的培训提供了更强有力的参考。 广泛的实验表明,TT-RSI比基模提高13.89%的平均精度,并在相同的试验时间缩放预算下比最强的自相容性方法提高4.79%.

articles.title: LimeTree: Linear-Memory Graph Neural Networks over Tree-Graphs for Resource-Efficient Language Modeling and Context Extrapolation
articles.content: The search for computationally efficient alternatives to the Transformer has yielded numerous architectures in recent years; however, most exhibit severe weaknesses in associative recall-such as key-value (KV) retrieval-and length extrapolation, where even standard Transformers struggle. This paper introduces LimeTree, a linear-complexity architecture in both memory and compute for sequence modeling. By integrating synthetic KV retrieval tasks directly into standard language modeling training, LimeTree achieves strong perplexity alongside reliable recall. Two variants were evaluated on WikiText-103 and PG-19 under strict compute constraints. On WikiText-103, LimeTree reaches a token-level perplexity of 19 in just 6 hours on four Quadro RTX 8000 GPUs, while maintaining 100\% KV retrieval accuracy even when extrapolating from a training context length of 512 to an evaluation length of 16,384. On PG-19, the model achieves a token-level perplexity of 13 in 35 hours on a single RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU with minimal hyperparameter tuning. These results position LimeTree as a competitive linear-complexity alternative to Transformers, combining superior perplexity and training throughput with robust in-context retrieval and length extrapolation.

articles.title: PRIMEAPE: A Multilingual Benchmark for Fine-Grained Meta-Evaluation of Judge Models
articles.content: Large language models increasingly serve as judges of other models, shaping benchmark rankings and model development. Yet, a judge whose rationale consistently supports its verdict may still disagree with human preferences. To study this, we introduce PRIMEAPE, a multilingual benchmark for evaluating judge verdicts and rationales. PRIMEAPE provides 2,205 response pairs covering 243 instructions in English, French, Spanish, Urdu, Hindi, Norwegian Bokmål, and Yoruba, with 11k human annotations of preferences and rationales across relevance, naturalness, truthfulness, safety, and overall quality. Our evaluation of twelve open- and closed-weight judges reveals that aggregate performance conceals differences across languages and criteria, while requesting rationales does not consistently improve agreement with human preferences. Judges also favor the first position, longer responses, and responses from related models, with effects that vary across criteria and languages. Crucially, judges can justify verdicts that disagree with human preferences while maintaining consistency between their verdicts and rationales. These findings show that consistency with a judge's own verdict does not establish alignment with human judgment. PRIMEAPE enables assessment of both, providing a foundation for more reliable multilingual judges. We release our benchmark and all annotation materials under the CC BY-NC 4.0 license at github.com/Toloka/primeape.

articles.title: Semantic-aware Decoding for Diverse Text-to-SQL under Schema Ambiguity
articles.content: Real-world text-to-SQL systems often face schema ambiguity, where a question can map to multiple plausible schema elements. To support downstream disambiguation, SQL generation systems should include diverse interpretations among their top-k predictions. However, large language models (LLMs) typically favor a single interpretation, producing highly skewed outputs. We propose Semantic-aware Logit Adjustment (SLA), a training-free decoding method that promotes diverse SQL generation by adjusting token logits based on semantic similarity between schema elements. Unlike prior approaches that rely on reasoning-intensive prompting or task-specific fine-tuning, SLA is efficient, model-agnostic, and easy to deploy. Experiments show that SLA consistently improves interpretation coverage over standard decoding and remains competitive with existing diversity-oriented methods at substantially lower inference cost.

articles.title_zh: 在Schema Ambiguity 下对不同文本进行语义意识解码
articles.content_zh: Real-world text-to-SQL系统经常面临计划模糊,其中一个问题可以映射到多种可能的计划元素. 为了支持下游的混淆,SQL生成系统应当在其顶端k的预测中包括不同的解释. 然而,大型语言模型通常倾向于单一解释,产生高度扭曲的产出。 我们提出语义感知逻辑调整(SLA),这是一种无训练解码方法,它通过根据语义学在计数元素之间的相似性来调整符号日志,促进多种SQL生成. 与以往依赖推理密集的提示或任务特定微调的方法不同,SLA是高效的,模式不可知的,易于部署. 实验表明,苏丹解放军在标准解码方面不断提高口译覆盖面,并且仍然与现有的以多样性为导向的方法有竞争力,其推论成本要低得多。
